报告题目：华谊兄弟在电影市场上的优势分析

1. 强大的制作实力和专业团队：
华谊兄弟作为中国电影产业的领军企业之一，拥有雄厚的制作实力和多年的经验积累。公司以高质量的电影制作闻名，拥有一支由优秀的导演、编剧、演员和技术人员组成的专业团队。这确保了他们能够制作出精心策划、制作精良的电影作品。

2. 全产业链布局和强大的资源整合能力：
华谊兄弟在电影产业上实现了全产业链布局，涵盖了电影制作、发行、投资、演艺经纪和影视娱乐等多个环节。该布局使得华谊兄弟能够在各个环节中充分整合资源，优化产业链效益。同时，公司还通过与国内外优秀的制片公司、发行公司以及海外公司的合作，实现了扩大影片国内外市场份额的战略目标。

3. 丰富的IP资源和品牌效应：
华谊兄弟积极拓展并积累了丰富的IP资源，包括源于文学作品、漫画、游戏等各个领域。这些IP作品在影视改编过程中，可以借助原作粉丝群体的关注度和影响力，为影片带来较大的关注度和票房号召力。同时，华谊兄弟作为一家知名的品牌，在市场上享有较高的知名度和美誉度，这也为其电影作品带来了品牌效应和市场优势。

4. 经验丰富的投资能力：
除了自主制作电影，华谊兄弟还以投资方式参与了众多优秀影片的制作。通过投资不同类型和风格的电影作品，华谊兄弟在产业链上实现了多元化布局，并积累了丰富的市场经验。这种投资能力使得公司能够在投资决策上抓住市场机遇，同时也分散了风险。

5. 稳定的市场地位和良好的口碑影响力：
作为中国电影产业的佼佼者，华谊兄弟积累了广泛的观众基础和较为稳定的市场地位。公司制作的电影作品获得了多个重要电影奖项，同时也获得了观众的认可和口碑的推动。这使得华谊兄弟在市场中具有较高的竞争力和影响力。

总结：
华谊兄弟在电影市场上具备强大的制作实力、全产业链布局和资源整合能力，拥有丰富的IP资源和良好的品牌效应。同时，公司还具备投资能力和稳定的市场地位，积累了良好的口碑影响力。这些优势使得华谊兄弟能够在电影市场上保持竞争力，获取更多的市场份额和商业利益。

以上是对华谊兄弟在电影市场上的优势进行的分析报告。请注意，电影市场竞争激烈，市场优势可能随时受到变化。华谊兄弟需要继续保持创新能力和敏锐的市场洞察力，以适应行业变化和观众需求的不断变化。同时，加强与优秀制片公司和导演的合作，培养新人才，保持技术和创作水平的提升也非常重要。通过不断提高制作品质和创新能力，华谊兄弟将能够进一步巩固其在电影市场上的竞争优势，实现更加成功的发展。
instruction_en:
The following is an analysis report on the film industry. First, identify the key points in the report using the original text, and then generate a new analysis report on one of the points, with a sharp language style.

Report Title: Analysis of Huayi Brothers' Advantages in the Film Market

1. Strong Production Capabilities and Professional Team:
As one of the leading enterprises in China's film industry, Huayi Brothers possesses robust production capabilities and years of accumulated experience. The company is renowned for high-quality film production and has a professional team composed of outstanding directors, screenwriters, actors, and technicians. This ensures they can produce meticulously planned and well-made film works.

2. Comprehensive Industry Chain Layout and Strong Resource Integration Capability:
Huayi Brothers has achieved a comprehensive industry chain layout in the film industry, covering multiple segments such as film production, distribution, investment, entertainment agency, and film and television entertainment. This layout enables Huayi Brothers to fully integrate resources in various segments, optimizing the benefits of the industry chain. Additionally, through cooperation with excellent domestic and international production companies, distribution companies, and overseas companies, the company has achieved the strategic goal of expanding the market share of films both domestically and internationally.

3. Rich IP Resources and Brand Effect:
Huayi Brothers actively expands and accumulates rich IP resources, including those derived from literary works, comics, games, and other fields. These IP works, during the adaptation process, can leverage the attention and influence of the original fan base, bringing significant attention and box office appeal to the films. Meanwhile, as a well-known brand, Huayi Brothers enjoys high market recognition and reputation, which also brings brand effects and market advantages to its film works.

4. Rich Investment Experience:
In addition to self-producing films, Huayi Brothers also participates in the production of many excellent films through investment. By investing in films of different types and styles, Huayi Brothers has achieved diversified layout in the industry chain and accumulated rich market experience. This investment capability allows the company to seize market opportunities in investment decisions, while also dispersing risks.

5. Stable Market Position and Good Reputation Influence:
As a leading player in China's film industry, Huayi Brothers has accumulated a broad audience base and relatively stable market position. The films produced by the company have won multiple significant film awards and gained audience recognition and reputation boosts. This gives Huayi Brothers high competitiveness and influence in the market.

Summary:
Huayi Brothers possesses strong production capabilities, a comprehensive industry chain layout, and resource integration capacity in the film market. The company owns rich IP resources and has a good brand effect. Additionally, it has investment capability and a stable market position, accumulating good reputation influence. These advantages enable Huayi Brothers to maintain competitiveness in the film market, securing more market share and commercial benefits.

The above is an analysis report of Huayi Brothers' advantages in the film market. Please note that the film market is highly competitive, and market advantages may change at any time. Huayi Brothers needs to continue maintaining innovation capabilities and keen market insight to adapt to the ever-changing industry and audience demands. Moreover, strengthening cooperation with excellent production companies and directors, nurturing new talent, and maintaining improvements in technology and creative levels are also very important. By continuously improving production quality and innovation capabilities, Huayi Brothers will be able to further consolidate its competitive advantage in the film market and achieve more successful development.

instruction:
请先根据以下政策原文，构造2个有关问题并回答，回答部分必须引用政策原文。再根据这两个问题生成一篇报道，要求内容前后一致，最后再输出该报道的英文翻译。
政策原文："""二、偿还购房贷款本息提取
（一）偿还苏州本地贷款还贷委托提取
1、还贷委托提取签约
（1）办理条件
①贷款性质非住房贷款的，不能办理提取。
②贷款银行已经与公积金中心签约。
③委托人如有多笔住房贷款的，只能委托其中一笔，且公积金贷款须优先办理；
④还贷委托提取期间，职工不得参与另一笔住房贷款的还贷委托提取或办理柜面提取。
⑤符合条件的公积金贷款、组合贷款、商业贷款均可以办理还贷委托提取业务
（2）办理要件
①办理职工身份证件原件（居民身份证或台湾居民来往内地通行证或港澳居民来往内地通行证）；
②银行借款合同原件(公积金贷款<含组合>无需提供）；
③银行指定扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）原件。
④如申请办理还贷委托提取的职工不是借款人，需提供与借款人的关系证明（如结婚证或户口簿等）。
（3）办理方式
①线下办理：
a贷款银行已与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至贷款银行承办网点进行业务申请（建议拨打12329确认银行是否联网以及办理地点）
b贷款银行未与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至贷款银行承办网点签订纸质《偿还住房贷款委托提取住房公积金协议》——职工携带签约材料及协议到公积金中心进行录入（建议拨打12329确认银行是否联网以及办理地点）
②线上办理：
a苏州公积金APP：业务办理中还贷委提业务，输入交易密码验证后办理签订还贷委提协议（目前办理业务可以选择的贷款银行有：工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行、交通银行、中信银行、光大银行、华夏银行、民生银行、平安银行、招商银行、兴业银行、苏州银行、张家港农村商业银行、常熟农村商业银行、昆山农村商业银行、太仓农村商业银行、 苏州农村商业银行、江苏银行、广东发展银行、宁波银行、上海银行、江西银行、浙商银行、渤海银行、江南农村商业银行、上海浦东发展银行）
b个人网厅：登录苏州公积金官网，在网上服务旗舰店，选择个人网上业务，使用个人业务登陆，在系统菜单内选择个人提取，办理还贷委提协议签订
注：如贷款银行不在以上银行名单中，职工需办理还贷提取的，参见业务指南：《还贷提取（归还外地住房贷款）》
（3）提取人员
①借款人、配偶、借款人同一本户口簿的直系亲属（父母、子女、子女配偶）
②仅限本人办理，不能代办
（5）承诺时间
协议于签订后次月生效，中心于每月18日、26日（遇法定假日顺延）提取，5个工作日内将所提取的公积金转入到职工指定的扣款银行账户。
（6）友情提取
①职工（含配偶）购买、建造、翻建、大修自住住房或偿还各类住房贷款本息的，可以提取住房公积金。各类住房贷款包括住房公积金贷款、商业性住房贷款、住房公积金与商业组合贷款。职工偿还苏州大市范围内的住房公积金贷款本息、住房公积金与商业性组合贷款本息、与苏州市住房公积金管理中心签约的商业银行发放的商业性住房贷款本息的，实行还贷委托提取住房公积金方式。
②还贷委托提取住房公积金，是指缴存住房公积金的职工委托所在地公积金管理机构和贷款银行，在其按月偿还住房贷款后，依据其按月偿还贷款情况提取公积金（含新职工住房补贴），并直接划转到指定扣款还贷的个人银行账户。职工以还贷委托提取的形式提取的，公积金中心按照《偿还住房贷款委托提取住房公积金协议》的约定按月将可以提取的公积金转账至指定还款银行卡，住房贷款本息全部还清后，《委提协议》自动终止。
（7）提取额度
委托人公积金账户应当至少保留最新一个月的缴存额（不含新职工补贴），留存额以上部分大于、等于累积还款额与累计提取额之差的，按累积还款额与累积提取额之差提取；小于的，按留存额以上部分提取，如多人委托的，公积金中心依借款人、配偶、与借款人同一户口簿内直系亲属（含配偶）为序提取，提取额不超过累积还款额与累计提取额之差。
（8）政策依据
《住房公积金管理条例》《苏州市住房公积金管理办法》《关于印发〈苏州市住房公积金缴存职工购建住房还贷提取住房公积金实施细则〉的通知》（苏房金规〔文件2018〕5号）。
2、还贷委托提取变更
（1）办理条件
①借款职工已签订《委提协议》，尚未还清贷款，并出现以下情况：
②委提成员增加或减少的；
③公积金帐号变化的；
④扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）更换或改变的；
⑤其它原因，可以进行委提变更。
⑥委提日每月18日、26日（遇法定假日顺延）不能进行变更
（2）办理要件
①身份证件原件（居民身份证或台湾居民来往内地通行证或港澳居民来往内地通行证）；
②原《委提协议》；
③银行指定扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）；
④如需新增或减少非借款人的其他人员，还需提供结婚证或户口簿。
⑤银行指定扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）变更为其他人的，还需提供结婚证或户口簿等直系亲属关系证明材料及银行机构出具的变更回执或目前该笔贷款指定的扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）相关信息的证明。
（3）办理方式
①线下办理：
a已与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至委提协议签约网点进行业务申请，当场填写《偿还住房贷款委托提取住房公积金变更表》
b未与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至委提协议签约网点进行业务申请，当场填写《偿还住房贷款委托提取住房公积金变更表》职工凭上述材料到公积金中心进行系统录入
②线上办理：
a苏州公积金APP：业务办理中还贷委提业务，输入交易密码验证后办理委提增加共同提取人/终止还贷委提/委提收款银行卡变更（根据变更原因不同，选择不同的菜单）
b个人网厅：登录苏州公积金官网，在网上服务旗舰店内，选择个人网上业务，使用个人业务登陆，在系统菜单内的个人提取，办理添加共同申请人/终止还贷委提（根据变更原因不同，选择不同的菜单。官网不能办理委提银行卡变更）
（4）办理人员
①借款人、配偶、同一本户口簿的直系亲属（仅限借款人的父母、子女、子女配偶）
②仅限本人办理，不能代办
（5）生效时间
变更信息录入后，在次日生效执行
（6）友情提示
①相关人员应到场办理；
②公积金贷款的银行指定扣款还贷的银行存折（卡）变更为其他人的，仅需提供结婚证或户口簿等直系亲属关系证明材料。
（7）政策依据
《住房公积金管理条例》《苏州市住房公积金管理办法》《关于印发〈苏州市住房公积金缴存职工购建住房还贷提取住房公积金实施细则〉的通知》（苏房金规〔文件2018〕5号）。
3、还贷委托提取解除
（1）办理条件
①职工已签订《委提协议》，尚未还清贷款， 因故需要解除的。
②住房贷款本息全部还清后，《委提协议》自动终止。职工因故需要变更、解除《委提协议》的，按《委提协议》约定办理。
（2）办理要件
①身份证件原件（居民身份证或台湾居民来往内地通行证或港澳居民来往内地通行证）；
②原《委提协议》；
③原《委提协议》内有多人的，还需提供结婚证或户口簿。
（3）办理方式
①线下办理：
a已与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至委提协议签约网点进行业务申请
b未与中心系统联网的银行，职工带齐材料至委提协议签约网点进行业务申请，职工现场填写《偿还住房贷款委托提取住房公积金协议解除表》将职工凭上述材料到公积金中心进行系统录入
②线上办理
a苏州公积金APP：业务办理，选择还贷委提业务，输入交易密码验证后办理终止还贷委提（所有参与委提的职工都需要登陆自己的APP办理终止）
b个人网厅：登录苏州公积金官网，在网上服务旗舰店，选择个人网上业务，使用个人业务登陆，在系统菜单中选择个人提取，办理终止还贷委提（所有参与委提的职工都需要登陆自己的APP办理终止）
（4）办理人员
①所有参与委提职工
②仅限本人办理，不能代办
（5）承诺时间
①手工解除还贷委提的，在次日生效执行。
②住房贷款本息全部还清的，委托协议从贷款还清后的次月提取公积金后自然终止。
（6）友情提示
①参与委提职工需同时到场办理；
②解除信息录入后，在次日生效执行；
③住房贷款本息全部还清的，委托协议从次月提取公积金后自然终止。
④职工已经签订《还贷委提协议》，在提前还清住房贷款后，需在近期申请住房公积金贷款的，为保证有足够的余额，请在还清贷款的次月公积金中心发起还贷委托提取日（每月18日，遇节假日顺延）前到原经办网点办理解除《还贷委提协议》手续。
（7）政策依据
《住房公积金管理条例》《苏州市住房公积金管理办法》《关于印发〈苏州市住房公积金缴存职工购建住房还贷提取住房公积金实施细则〉的通知》（苏房金规〔文件2018〕5号）。
（二）归还外地住房贷款还贷提取
1、办理条件
（1）职工在苏州大市范围外存在未还清的住房贷款；
（2）职工在苏州大市范围内存在各类未还清的住房贷款，但贷款银行尚未与中心签约；
（3）职工在本外地同时有住房贷款的，苏州大市范围内的住房贷款优先偿还。    
2、办理要件
（1）身份证件原件（居民身份证或台湾居民来往内地通行证或港澳居民来往内地通行证）；
（2）借款合同原件；
（3）银行盖章的还贷证明（含还款明细、贷款账号、贷款人身份信息等）原件（还贷证明当年有效）；
材料获取：贷款银行或异地公积金中心出具
（4）如申请还贷提取的职工不是借款人，需提供结婚证或户口簿
（5）与住房公积金个人账户关联的银行卡（如尚未办理关联或需要变更银行卡，需提供苏州大市范围内工、建、农、中、交、苏州任一一家银行发出的本人借记卡）。
3、办理方式
职工带齐材料至办理场所进行提取申请，提交至工作人员进行审核，审核后符合提取条件,把提取的住房公积金实时划转至职工关联的银行借记卡中（全市通办）
4、提取人员
职工、配偶、同一本户口簿的直系亲属（父母、子女、子女配偶）
5、提取额度
一年可以提取两次，无时间间隔要求，个人住房公积金账户至少需按最新缴存基数留存一个月的缴存额（不含新职工补贴）。
6、友情提示
（1）住房公积金提取业务可由职工本人办理或委托他人代为办理。如委托他人代办的，代办人应知晓委托人已设置的住房公积金卡密码，并提供委托书、双方身份证、委托人指定银行有效借记卡（已经与住房公积金个人账户关联的无需提供）。
（2）未与中心签约的苏州大市范围内的其他商业银行的住房贷款参照外地住房贷款还贷提取办理。
（3）职工在本外地同时有住房贷款的，苏州大市范围内的住房贷款优先偿还。
7、承诺时间
审核通过，当天到账
8、政策依据
《住房公积金管理条例》《苏州市住房公积金管理办法》《关于印发〈苏州市住房公积金缴存职工购建住房还贷提取住房公积金实施细则〉的通知》（苏房金规〔文件2018〕5号）。



八、贷款年限
（一）住房公积金贷款期限以年为单位，借款申请人年龄与申请贷款期限之和不超过其法定退休年龄后5年（国家另有规定可延长的，不超过延长后的退休年龄后5年，最长不得超过70周岁）。
（二）新建住房的贷款年限最长不超过30年；
（三）存量成套住房、建造住房、翻建住房的贷款期限最长不超过30年，且存量成套住房的贷款期限不得超出所购住房的剩余使用年限。
instruction_en:
Please first generate two relevant questions based on the original policy text and answer them. The answer section must quote the original policy text. Then generate a report based on these two questions, ensuring consistency in content, and finally output the English translation of the report.
Original policy text: """2. Withdraw the principal and interest used to repay the housing loan
（1） Entrusted withdrawal for repayment of local loans in Suzhou
1. Contract for entrusted withdrawal of loan repayment
(1) Processing conditions
① If the nature of the loan is not a housing loan, it cannot be withdrawn.
② The loan bank has signed a contract with the housing provident fund center.
③ If the principal has multiple housing loans, only one of them can be entrusted, and the housing provident fund loan must be processed first;
④ During the period of entrusted loan repayment withdrawal, employees are not allowed to participate in the entrusted withdrawal or counter withdrawal of another housing loan.
⑤ Eligible housing provident fund loans, combination loans, and commercial loans can all handle entrusted loan repayment and withdrawal services
(2) Requirements for Handling
① Apply for the original employee ID card (resident ID card or Taiwan resident travel permit to mainland China or Hong Kong and Macao resident travel permit to mainland China);
② Original bank loan contract (provident fund loan<including combination>does not need to be provided);
③ The original bank passbook (card) designated by the bank for deducting and repaying the loan.
④ If the employee applying for loan repayment commission withdrawal is not the borrower, proof of relationship with the borrower (such as marriage certificate or household registration book) must be provided.
(3) Handling method
① Offline processing:
A loan bank has already connected to the central system. Employees should bring all necessary materials to the loan bank's handling branch to apply for business (it is recommended to call 12329 to confirm whether the bank is connected and the processing location)
For banks where the loan bank is not connected to the central system, employees should bring all the necessary materials to the loan bank's handling branch to sign a paper "Agreement on Entrusting the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for Repayment of Housing Loans". Employees should bring the signed materials and agreement to the provident fund center for input (it is recommended to call 12329 to confirm whether the bank is connected and the processing location)
② Online processing:
Suzhou Housing Provident Fund APP: In the process of handling loan repayment and withdrawal business, enter the transaction password for verification and sign the loan repayment and withdrawal agreement (currently available loan banks for handling business include Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, Construction Bank, Bank of Communications, CITIC Bank, Everbright Bank, Huaxia Bank, Minsheng Bank, Ping An Bank, China Merchants Bank, Industrial Bank, Suzhou Bank, Zhangjiagang Rural Commercial Bank, Changshu Rural Commercial Bank, Kunshan Rural Commercial Bank, Taicang Rural Commercial Bank, Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank, Jiangsu Bank, Guangdong Development Bank, Ningbo Bank, Shanghai Bank, Jiangxi Bank, Zhejiang Commercial Bank, Bohai Bank, Jiangnan Rural Commercial Bank, Shanghai Pudong Development Bank)
B Personal Online Hall: Log in to the Suzhou Housing Provident Fund official website, go to the online service flagship store, select Personal Online Business, log in using Personal Business, select Personal Withdrawal from the system menu, and sign the loan repayment commission agreement
Note: If the lending bank is not included in the above list of banks and employees need to handle loan repayment and withdrawal, please refer to the business guide: "Loan Repayment and Withdrawal (Repayment of Non local Housing Loans)"
(3) Extract personnel
① Borrower, spouse, and direct relatives of the borrower with the same household registration book (parents, children, children's spouses)
② Only for personal use, cannot be handled on behalf of others
(5) Promise time
The agreement shall come into effect the following month after signing, and the center shall withdraw the provident fund on the 18th and 26th of each month (postponed in case of statutory holidays). Within 5 working days, the withdrawn provident fund shall be transferred to the designated deduction bank account of the employee.
(6) Friendship Extraction
① Employees (including spouses) who purchase, construct, renovate, or repair self occupied housing or repay the principal and interest of various housing loans can withdraw their housing provident fund. Various types of housing loans include housing provident fund loans, commercial housing loans, and a combination of housing provident fund and commercial loans. Employees who repay the principal and interest of housing provident fund loans within the Suzhou metropolitan area, the principal and interest of housing provident fund and commercial combination loans, and the principal and interest of commercial housing loans issued by commercial banks signed with the Suzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center, shall be subject to the entrusted withdrawal of housing provident fund for repayment.
② Entrusting the withdrawal of housing provident fund for loan repayment refers to the situation where an employee who has deposited housing provident fund entrusts the local housing provident fund management agency and loan bank to withdraw the provident fund (including new employee housing subsidies) based on their monthly repayment of housing loans, and directly transfer it to a designated personal bank account for deduction and repayment. If employees withdraw their housing provident fund through entrusted repayment, the housing provident fund center shall transfer the withdrawable provident fund to the designated repayment bank card on a monthly basis in accordance with the "Agreement on Entrusted Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for Repayment of Housing Loans". After the principal and interest of the housing loan are fully repaid, the "Entrusted Withdrawal Agreement" shall automatically terminate.
(7) Withdrawal limit
The principal's provident fund account shall retain at least one month's deposit amount (excluding new employee subsidies). If the portion above the retention amount is greater than or equal to the difference between the cumulative repayment amount and the cumulative withdrawal amount, the withdrawal shall be made based on the difference between the cumulative repayment amount and the cumulative withdrawal amount; If the amount is less than, it shall be withdrawn according to the portion above the retention amount. If multiple people entrust, the housing provident fund center shall withdraw in order of the borrower, spouse, and direct relatives (including spouse) in the same household registration book as the borrower, and the withdrawal amount shall not exceed the difference between the cumulative repayment amount and the cumulative withdrawal amount.
(8) Policy Basis
The Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund, the Measures for the Administration of Housing Provident Fund in Suzhou, and the Notice on Issuing the Implementation Rules for the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for the Purchase and Construction of Housing by Employees Who Make Housing Provident Fund Deposits in Suzhou (SFJG [Document 2018] No. 5).
2. Change of loan repayment commission withdrawal
(1) Processing conditions
① The borrowing employee has signed the "Entrustment Agreement" and has not yet repaid the loan, and the following situations have occurred:
② Increase or decrease of appointed members;
③ Changes in the housing provident fund account;
④ The bank passbook (card) for deducting and repaying the loan has been replaced or changed;
⑤ For other reasons, changes can be made through delegation.
⑥ The commission date cannot be changed on the 18th and 26th of each month (postponed in case of statutory holidays)
(2) Requirements for Handling
① Original ID card (resident ID card or Taiwan resident travel permit to mainland China or Hong Kong and Macao resident travel permit to mainland China);
② The original 'Commission Agreement';
③ The bank passbook (card) designated by the bank for deducting and repaying loans;
④ If it is necessary to add or reduce non borrower personnel, a marriage certificate or household registration book must also be provided.
⑤ If the bank's designated debit and repayment bank passbook (card) is changed to another person, proof of direct family relationship such as marriage certificate or household registration book, as well as a change receipt issued by the bank institution or proof of relevant information of the bank passbook (card) designated for debit and repayment of the loan, must be provided.
(3) Handling method
① Offline processing:
A bank that has been connected to the central system should bring all necessary materials to the designated agreement signing branch for business application, and fill out the "Change Form for Entrusted Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for Repayment of Housing Loans" on the spot
For banks that are not connected to the central system, employees should bring all the necessary materials to the contracted branch of the commission agreement to apply for business. They should fill out the "Change Form for Entrusted Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for Repayment of Housing Loans" on the spot and enter it into the system at the provident fund center with the above materials
② Online processing:
Suzhou Housing Provident Fund APP: In the process of handling loan repayment and withdrawal business, enter the transaction password to verify and proceed with the withdrawal. Add a co withdrawal person/terminate the loan repayment and withdrawal/change the bank card for the withdrawal (choose different menus depending on the reason for the change)
B Personal Online Hall: Log in to the official website of Suzhou Housing Provident Fund, select Personal Online Business in the online service flagship store, log in using Personal Business, select Personal Withdrawal in the system menu, and apply for adding co applicants/terminating loan repayment commission (different menus may be selected depending on the reason for the change. The official website cannot handle commission bank card changes)
(4) Handling personnel
① Borrower, spouse, and direct relatives of the same household registration book (limited to the borrower's parents, children, and children's spouses only)
② Only for personal use, cannot be handled on behalf of others
(5) Effective time
After the change information is entered, it will take effect and be executed the next day
(6) Friendly reminder
① Relevant personnel should be present to handle the matter;
② If the designated bank passbook (card) for deducting and repaying the housing provident fund loan is changed to someone else, only proof of direct family relationship such as marriage certificate or household registration book needs to be provided.
(7) Policy Basis
The Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund, the Measures for the Administration of Housing Provident Fund in Suzhou, and the Notice on Issuing the Implementation Rules for the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for the Purchase and Construction of Housing by Employees Who Make Housing Provident Fund Deposits in Suzhou (SFJG [Document 2018] No. 5).
3. Termination of loan repayment commission withdrawal
(1) Processing conditions
① The employee has signed the 'Entrustment Agreement' but has not yet repaid the loan and needs to be terminated due to unforeseen circumstances.
② After the principal and interest of the housing loan are fully repaid, the 'Entrustment Agreement' will automatically terminate. If an employee needs to change or terminate the 'Appointment Agreement' for any reason, it shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the 'Appointment Agreement'.
(2) Requirements for Handling
① Original ID card (resident ID card or Taiwan resident travel permit to mainland China or Hong Kong and Macao resident travel permit to mainland China);
② The original 'Commission Agreement';
③ If there are multiple people in the original 'Commission Agreement', a marriage certificate or household registration book must also be provided.
(3) Handling method
① Offline processing:
A bank that has been connected to the central system, employees should bring all necessary materials to the designated agreement signing branch for business application
For banks that are not connected to the central system, employees should bring all the necessary materials to the designated agreement signing branch to apply for business. Employees should fill out the "Agreement Termination Form for Repaying Housing Loans and Entrusting Housing Provident Fund Withdrawal" on site and enter the above materials into the provident fund center system
② Online processing
Suzhou Housing Provident Fund APP: Business processing, select the loan repayment commission business, enter the transaction password for verification, and terminate the loan repayment commission (all employees participating in the commission need to log in to their own APP to terminate)
B Personal Online Hall: Log in to the official website of Suzhou Housing Provident Fund, go to the online service flagship store, select Personal Online Business, log in using Personal Business, select Personal Withdrawal from the system menu, and apply for termination of loan repayment commission (all employees participating in the commission need to log in to their own APP to apply for termination)
(4) Handling personnel
① All employees participating in the commission
② Only for personal use, cannot be handled on behalf of others
(5) Promise time
① The manual termination of the loan repayment commission shall take effect and be executed on the following day.
② If the principal and interest of the housing loan are fully repaid, the commission agreement will naturally terminate after the withdrawal of the housing provident fund in the following month after the loan is repaid.
(6) Friendly reminder
① Employees participating in the commission must be present at the same time to handle it;
② After canceling the information entry, it will take effect and be executed the next day;
③ If the principal and interest of the housing loan are fully repaid, the commission agreement will naturally terminate after the withdrawal of the housing provident fund in the following month.
④ The employee has signed the "Loan Repayment Commission Agreement". If they need to apply for a housing provident fund loan in the near future after repaying the housing loan in advance, in order to ensure sufficient balance, please go to the original handling branch to handle the procedures for terminating the "Loan Repayment Commission Agreement" before the loan repayment commission withdrawal date (18th of each month, postponed in case of holidays) initiated by the provident fund center in the following month after repaying the loan.
(7) Policy Basis
The Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund, the Measures for the Administration of Housing Provident Fund in Suzhou, and the Notice on Issuing the Implementation Rules for the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for the Purchase and Construction of Housing by Employees Who Make Housing Provident Fund Deposits in Suzhou (SFJG [Document 2018] No. 5).
（2） Repayment and withdrawal of out of town housing loans
1. Processing conditions
(1) Employees have outstanding housing loans outside the Suzhou metropolitan area;
(2) Employees have various outstanding housing loans within the Suzhou metropolitan area, but the loan bank has not yet signed a contract with the center;
(3) If employees have housing loans in other cities, priority will be given to repaying housing loans within the Suzhou metropolitan area.
2. Requirements for Handling
(1) Original ID card (resident ID card or Taiwan resident travel permit to mainland China or Hong Kong and Macao resident travel permit to mainland China);
(2) Original loan contract;
(3) Original loan repayment certificate stamped by the bank (including repayment details, loan account number, borrower's identity information, etc.) (valid for the current year);
Material acquisition: Issued by the loan bank or a remote housing provident fund center
(4) If the employee applying for loan repayment is not the borrower, they need to provide their marriage certificate or household registration book
(5) The bank card associated with the personal account of the housing provident fund (if the association has not been processed or the bank card needs to be changed, one must provide a debit card issued by any bank within the Suzhou metropolitan area, including ICBC, CCB, ABC, CCCC, and SJTU).
3. Handling method
Employees bring all necessary documents to the processing location to apply for withdrawal, submit them to the staff for review, and if they meet the withdrawal criteria, the withdrawn housing provident fund will be transferred in real time to the employee's associated bank debit card (city wide application)
4. Extract personnel
Employees, spouses, and direct relatives with the same household registration book (parents, children, children's spouses)
5. Withdrawal limit
You can withdraw twice a year without any time interval requirement. Personal housing provident fund accounts must retain at least one month's deposit amount based on the latest deposit base (excluding new employee subsidies).
6. Friendly reminder
(1) The withdrawal of housing provident fund can be handled by the employee themselves or entrusted to others. If entrusted to someone else, the agent should be aware of the housing provident fund card password set by the principal, and provide a power of attorney, both parties' ID cards, and a valid debit card from the designated bank of the principal (not required for those already associated with the housing provident fund personal account).
(2) The housing loans of other commercial banks within the Suzhou metropolitan area that have not signed a contract with the center shall be processed in accordance with the loan repayment and withdrawal procedures for non local housing loans.
(3) If employees have housing loans in other cities, priority will be given to repaying housing loans within the Suzhou metropolitan area.
7. Promise time
Approved and credited on the same day
8. Policy Basis
The Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund, the Measures for the Administration of Housing Provident Fund in Suzhou, and the Notice on Issuing the Implementation Rules for the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for the Purchase and Construction of Housing by Employees Who Make Housing Provident Fund Deposits in Suzhou (SFJG [Document 2018] No. 5).



8、 Loan term
（1） The term of housing provident fund loans is measured in years, and the sum of the borrower's age and the loan application period shall not exceed 5 years after their statutory retirement age (if the state has other regulations that can be extended, it shall not exceed 5 years after the extended retirement age, and the longest shall not exceed 70 years old).
（2） The maximum loan term for new housing construction shall not exceed 30 years;
（3） The maximum loan term for existing complete sets of housing, construction housing, and reconstruction housing shall not exceed 30 years, and the loan term for existing complete sets of housing shall not exceed the remaining useful life of the purchased housing.

instruction:
你是一名资深的彭博社记者，请你对以下文章进行重点内容分析，全文不超过500字。分析要求注重整体性，不能分点。请注意，分析完成后需在结尾写上“彭博社记者”作为标记。

"即将年中，估计不少人要开始不怎么愉快地写年中复盘了。




不知道会不会有这样的总结：“开了十年公司，今年第一次赔钱。”这是我一猎头朋友对自己上半年业绩的感慨。




关于当下的形势，我也断断续续聊过一些，核心是要意识到拐点已经来了。新的通道，做事的逻辑和之前完全不一样。诸如消费不要上高杠杆，房子宁可租也不轻易买老破小，创业要放弃靠融资活着的幻想，自己造血。




工作上也是同样的道理，通过跳槽快速涨薪的时代过去了。那几年，各大互联网公司都在疯狂招聘，我们作为参与者，当然可以吃到红利。但现在，互联网公司疯狂扩张的日子一去不复返。全世界都在裁员，难以独善其身。




过去几年，字节跳动、快手、美团、蚂蚁金服、美团、滴滴、好未来、跟谁学、猿辅导等等公司都经历了员工人数的迅速膨胀。公司缺人，想招到好人才，钱自然就得给到位。于是，悄然之间，行业的平均工资以肉眼可见的速度水涨船高。




以 K12 火爆的那几年为例，恰好当时我也在这个行业。一些运营岗位的同学，工作经验也就三年左右，履历平平，但动辄就要出两万多的月薪，让我等中小公司叫苦不堪。你给不到？那不好意思，爷跳槽得至少加薪 30%。反正，此处不留爷，自有留爷处。




类似的例子屡见不鲜。我不知道用泡沫来形容那几年的行业发展是不是合适，但置身其中，我们能感受到那种上扬的趋势，并享受到了部分发展红利。




现在，各业务指数级增长的时代已经远去。即使 GPT 大模型这么火热，但也没有带来多少增量的就业机会。你看，王慧文的光年之外，拿了那么多融资，但人家说，整个公司 60 个人基本就够了。




2023 年马上就进入下半年了。我分享一点和猎头朋友聊天的信息，供你参考：




1、与前些年相比，今年的就业市场挺差的。年初大家都觉得疫情放开后，会慢慢回暖，但从数据来看，并没有（猎头朋友公司的数据，可能存在不完全归纳的问题，仅供参考）。未来几年，应该也会持续今年的状态，别抱有不切实际的幻想。




2、两类人群更难找工作，工龄低的和工龄高的，呈沙漏状。工龄低的一般可替代性强，另一头，工龄高的基本都是管理岗，也很难找到下家。




3、几个大厂断断续续还在招人，但准确的说，应该是换人和补人。换不太优秀的，补自然离职的。HC 卡的很死。大公司是这样，中小公司更是。所以，尽量不要冲动之下贸然离职。骑驴找马，先保护好自己。




4、HC 少，市场上简历又多，面试官肯定是优中选优。这时候，学历越来越成为第一把筛子，候选人只要不是 985 或者 211，在熟知的几家大厂里，基本拿不到面试机会，除非有过硬的作品。




5、一个观察，现在市面上前端工程师的简历特别多。前端的岗位需求在变少。这应该和很多公司不再开发新产品有关系。毕竟，起新楼时，才需要很多的前端岗位。




6、互联网行业正在回归理性，之前非理性繁荣有泡沫。最近有朋友问我，孩子高考志愿是否还报计算机专业，我的答案是：“互联网行业只是增长放缓，但不是衰退。数字化仍是一个大浪潮。”现在大厂的销售都需要有计算机背景了。




7、如果你所在的公司或者业务至今还没盈利，那多少需要给自己提个醒：老板指不定什么时候会裁员，要不然，他哪来的钱来继续发工资？阿里的分拆思路不也是这样么，某个业务要是一直不能盈利，也没人愿意投资，那就自生自灭。基本的商业常识。




8、跳槽时，尽量想清楚自己的发展诉求。每个人，不同阶段要提升的能力是不一样的，关注目标公司能否匹配自己下一阶段的发展规划，关注目标公司做的事情能否给自己带来新的机会。




9、降低涨薪预期。薪资合理即可，更多关注做的事能否让自己开阔起来
instruction_en:
You are a senior journalist at Bloomberg. Please provide a key content analysis of the following article in no more than 500 characters. The analysis should focus on overall cohesion and should not be broken into bullet points. Please note, the analysis should be signed off with 'Bloomberg Journalist' upon completion.

"As the mid-year approaches, many people are probably starting to write their mid-year reviews without much pleasure. I wonder if there will be summaries like: 'After running my company for ten years, this is the first year we lost money.' This is a reflection from one of my headhunter friends on their performance in the first half of the year. Regarding the current situation, I have discussed intermittently that the critical point is to realize a turning point has arrived. The new channels and methods of doing things are entirely different from before. For example, avoid high leverage in consumption, it is better to rent a house rather than hastily buying old and dilapidated properties, abandon the fantasy of surviving on financing in entrepreneurship, and find self-sustaining methods. The same logic applies to work, the era of quickly increasing salaries through job-hopping is over. During those years, major internet companies were frantically recruiting, and as participants, we naturally reaped the benefits. But now, the days of frantic expansion for internet companies are long gone. Layoffs are happening worldwide, making it hard to stay unaffected. In recent years, companies like ByteDance, Kuaishou, Meituan, Ant Group, Didi, TAL Education, GSX Techedu, Yuanfudao, and others have experienced rapid increases in employee numbers. Companies were short of people and had to pay top dollar to attract good talent. As a result, industry average salaries quietly and visibly soared. During those booming years for K12, I happened to be in that industry too. Some colleagues in operations, with only about three years of work experience and average resumes, were demanding monthly salaries of over 20, 000 RMB, causing significant strain for small and medium-sized companies like ours. Couldn't meet their demands? Sorry, they would job-hop for at least a 30% raise. After all, 'if one place doesn’t keep me, another will.' Such examples were not uncommon. I'm unsure if it’s appropriate to describe the industry's development during those years as a bubble, but being in it, we could feel the upward trend and enjoyed some of the growth dividends. Now, the days of exponential business growth are gone. Even the hot GPT models haven't brought many incremental job opportunities. Look at Wang Huiwen's Light Years Beyond, which received so much financing, but they said the whole company only needs about 60 people. With 2023 soon entering its second half, I want to share some information from chatting with a headhunter friend for your reference: 1. Compared to previous years, this year's job market is quite poor. At the beginning of the year, everyone thought the market would gradually recover after the pandemic opened up, but the data tells a different story (this is based on my headhunter friend's company data, which may not be fully conclusive, for reference only). The job market will likely continue this state for the next few years, so don't hold unrealistic expectations. 2. Two groups of people are finding it harder to get jobs: those with low and high seniority, forming an hourglass shape. Those with low seniority are generally easily replaceable, and at the other end, those with high seniority, mostly managerial positions, also find it challenging to find new jobs. 3. Several major companies are intermittently still hiring, but technically, they are replacing or supplementing staff due to natural attrition. Hiring is very stringent. This applies to large companies and even more so to small and medium-sized companies. So, try not to leave impulsively. Protect yourself first before switching jobs. 4. With few hiring opportunities (HC) and many resumes in the market, interviewers will undoubtedly select the best. Formal education is increasingly becoming the primary screening criterion. Candidates who didn’t graduate from top-tier universities (985 or 211) generally won’t get interview opportunities at renowned big companies, unless they have outstanding portfolios. 5. One observation: there are many frontend engineer resumes in the market now. The demand for frontend positions is declining. This is likely due to many companies not developing new products anymore. After all, you only need many frontend engineers when constructing new projects. 6. The internet industry is returning to rationality, the previous irrational prosperity was a bubble. Recently, a friend asked if their child should still choose computer science as a major for the college entrance exam, my answer was: 'The internet industry is merely slowing in growth, not declining. Digitization remains a major trend.' Nowadays, even sales positions at big companies require a computer science background. 7. If your company or business has not yet become profitable, it is time to be cautious: the boss might decide to lay off staff at any moment. Otherwise, where would he get the money to continue paying salaries? Alibaba's strategy of splitting up can be understood this way too—if a business cannot achieve profitability, and no one is willing to invest, it is left to fend for itself. This is basic business common sense. 8. When switching jobs, be clear about your development demands. At different stages, individuals need to enhance different skills. Focus on whether the target company can match your next stage development plan and whether the work will provide new opportunities. 9. Lower your salary increase expectations. Reasonable pay is sufficient, focus more on whether the work will broaden your horizons."

instruction:
市场洞察课程的内容描述是：市场洞察课程旨在帮助学员掌握市场洞察的定义、方法及应用。课程内容涵盖市场洞察的各个方面，包括宏观经济环境、行业生态和竞争、客户目标群体以及企业竞争力。通过深入分析市场需求，学员可以识别市场机会，精准定位目标人群，并制定有效的产品卖点和策略。此外，课程还将教授如何将市场洞察融入企业日常运营和决策过程中，从而提升企业竞争力。本课程采用实战教学，结合案例分析，帮助学员快速掌握市场洞察的关键技能。 

请你先将以上内容拆分为四个重点部分，然后选择其中一个部分写一篇不少于500字的描述。
instruction_en:
The content description of the Market Insight course is as follows: The Market Insight course aims to help students master the definitions, methods, and applications of market insights. The course content covers various aspects of market insights, including the macroeconomic environment, industry ecosystem and competition, target customer groups, and corporate competitiveness. 在一个繁华喧嚣的城市，有一位年轻人名叫李明，他在高楼大厦间度过了一段疲惫而单调的生活。渐渐地，城市的喧嚣让他感到厌倦，他渴望寻找一片宁静的天地，于是决定离开城市，前往远离尘嚣的山区隐居。
李明来到了一座宁静的山村，在山巅找到了一处僻静的小屋，开始了他的隐居生活。然而，他对这种自由自在的生活感到有些迷茫，对人生的意义产生了疑惑。
就在这时，一位白发苍苍的老人来到了他的小屋。老人深邃的眼神中透露出岁月的沉淀，他微笑着坐在李明对面。
\"年轻人，你来到这里是为了什么？\"老人温和地问道。
李明向老人诉说了自己在城市的厌倦和对人生意义的疑惑。老人听后微笑着，开始讲述三个故事。

请你续写上述内容，要求前后一致，内容连贯，不能出现“人生”这一词。

In a bustling and noisy city, there lived a young man named Li Ming who spent a tired and monotonous life amidst skyscrapers. Gradually, the hustle and bustle of the city made him feel weary, and he longed to find a peaceful place. Thus, he decided to leave the city and retreat to the mountains, far from the clamor. 
Li Ming arrived at a tranquil mountain village and found a secluded hut on the mountaintop, where he began his reclusive life. However, he felt somewhat confused about this carefree lifestyle and started to doubt the meaning of life. 
At this moment, an elderly man with white hair came to his hut. The old man's deep eyes revealed the precipitation of years, and he sat opposite Li Ming with a smile. 
\"Young man, why have you come here?\" the old man asked gently. 
Li Ming recounted his weariness of city life and his doubts about thethe meaning of life to the old man. After listening, the old man smiled and began to tell three stories.

白鹿原简介：
《白鹿原》以白嘉轩为叙事核心，白鹿两家矛盾纠葛组织情节，以反映白嘉轩所代表的宗法家族制度及儒家伦理道德，在时代变迁与政治运动中的坚守与颓败为叙事线索，讲述了白鹿原村里两大家族白家和鹿家之间的故事。白家人沿袭村子里的族长，主人公白嘉轩一生娶过七个妻子，最后一个陪他终生，并育有三儿一女（白孝文、白孝武、白孝义、白灵）。鹿三是白家的长工，黑娃是他的长子。鹿家以鹿子霖为代表，他有两个儿子（鹿兆鹏、鹿兆海）。 
小说主要讲述了他们的下一代白孝文、鹿兆海、黑娃这一代人的生活：白家后代中规中矩，黑娃却从小就显现出不安分。长大后，白孝文继任族长，黑娃在外做长工，认识了东家的小老婆田小娥，他将她带回村后，受到村人的排斥。黑娃离开村子后投奔革命军，又成为土匪。在此期间鹿子霖、白孝文等都吸上了鸦片，将家败光，去异乡谋生。鹿三以儿媳田小娥为耻，最终杀了她，因终日被田小娥死时的情形折磨而死去。白孝文则在外重新振作，终有一番作为，白灵加入了共产党。一个家庭两代子孙，为争夺白鹿原的统治代代争斗不已。

请先找出以下信息：叙事核心是（），加入共产党的是（），杀死田小娥的是（），继任族长的是（）。
然后对以上情节内容补充扩写一下，必须包含“田小娥之死”这个情节标题。
instruction_en:
Brief Introduction of 'Bai Lu Yuan': 
'Bai Lu Yuan' centers around Bai Jiaxuan as the narrative core, depicting the conflicts and entanglements between the Bai and Lu families. Through this narrative, it reflects the patriarchal family system and Confucian ethics represented by Bai Jiaxuan, highlighting their persistence and decline amid societal changes and political movements. The story revolves around two major families, the Bai family and the Lu family, in Bai Lu Yuan village. The Bai family has traditionally held the village chief position, and the protagonist Bai Jiaxuan has married seven wives throughout his life, the last of whom stayed with him until his death. He has three sons and one daughter (Bai Xiaowen, Bai Xiaowu, Bai Xiaoyi, and Bai Ling). Lu San is a long-term laborer for the Bai family, and Hei Wa is his eldest son. The Lu family is represented by Lu Zilin, who has two sons (Lu Zhaopeng and Lu Zhaohai). 
The novel mainly recounts the lives of the next generation: Bai Xiaowen, Lu Zhaohai, and Hei Wa. Among the descendants of the Bai family, they are on the straight and narrow, whereas Hei Wa exhibits a restless spirit from a young age. As an adult, Bai Xiaowen succeeds as the village chief, and Hei Wa works as a long-term laborer outside the village, where he meets Tian Xiao'e, the concubine of his employer. He brings her back to the village, but she faces ostracism from the villagers. After leaving the village, Hei Wa joins the revolutionary army and later becomes a bandit. During this time, Lu Zilin, Bai Xiaowen, and others become addicted to opium, squandering their family's fortune and ultimately seeking livelihoods elsewhere. Lu San felt ashamed of his daughter-in-law Tian Xiao'e and ultimately killed her. He died because he was tormented by the circumstances of Tian Xiao'e's death all day long. Meanwhile, Bai Xiaowen regains his strength and manages to achieve some success abroad, and Bai Ling joins the Communist Party. In a family with two generations of descendants, they have been constantly fighting for generations to gain dominance over Bailuyuan.
First, find the following information: The narrative core is (), the one who joins the Communist Party is (), the person who kills Tian Xiao'e is (), and the successor as village chief is (). 
Then supplement and expand the above plot content, which must include the title of "The Death of Tian Xiao'e".

唐代·灵澈禅师
年老心闲无外事，
麻衣草座亦容身。
相逢尽道休官好，
林下何曾见一人。
如今年纪大了，心里不再牵挂世俗的事了，粗布衣和蒲团也可以安身度日。
遇到的朝廷中人都说不愿再做官了，可是又曾见到哪一个人真的放弃官位来隐居山林。
自己清净修行，与世无争的隐居生涯。

instruction_en:
《东林寺酬韦丹刺史》
Tang Dynasty · Zen Master Lingche
年老心闲无外事，
麻衣草座亦容身。
相逢尽道休官好，
林下何曾见一人。
Now that I am old, my heart is no longer concerned about worldly things. Rough cloth garments and a straw cushion suffice for a peaceful life.
Courtiers I encounter all claim they do not wish to hold office anymore, but have I ever seen anyone truly abandon their position to live in seclusion in the mountains?
Leading a secluded life of pure spiritual practice and standing aloof from worldly affairs.

From conducting market research and project evaluation consulting, to fully participating in the design and implementation of banking strategic transformation plans, from assisting some banks in post-loan risk information monitoring, to providing marketing and risk management consulting services to hundreds of banks, Bank A, with its advanced technology and excellent service, has always been at the forefront of banking information and consulting services. Bank A currently has more than 160 full-time research and consulting personnel, of whom 95% hold master's degrees or higher. The company publishes over 200 various research reports annually and serves more than 700 banks domestically and internationally on a long-term basis. Bank A has developed a unique system for banking market monitoring, customer positioning, product development, talent training, and network services.
Answer a few of my questions in text, then wrap your answers in a json format and send them back to me. Question 1: What kind of company is Bank A? Question 2: When was Bank A founded? Question 3: Write A slogan for Bank A. The answer to the model output is found from the given text information.

Minimum Repayment Amount. During each billing cycle, the cardholder is required to pay at least a certain percentage of the billed amount, usually 5% or 10%, as the minimum repayment amount. 
Full Repayment. Cardholders may also choose to make full repayment, meaning they pay the entire billed amount, including purchases, interest, and fees, before the repayment date.

你作为一个小学六年级的语文老师，请批阅以下日记，请指出优点和缺点，并写出修改方案，参考六年级学生日记。（需要严格遵守前后一致的原则，严格根据日记原文进行评阅。）

“上课铃才刚刚打响,英语老师就大步流星地进了教室。手中拿着厚厚的一卷教试卷，台下，同学们一下子炸开了。

“今天怎么要考试啊?英语老师没有说呀。”

“我没有复习,这可怎么办?”

我也愣在了座位上,因为没有复习的也算我一个。正想着，同桌把试卷传到了我的桌子上，我环顾四周，大家都已经开始答题了,我收回目光，把它移到试卷上的第一题.......

时间一分一秒地流过，我的心态也越来越不安。转动的声音在我耳中就像是蚊子叫，十分气人。看着试卷上一个个英语字母,为什么当它们拼在一起时我就不会了呢？太气人了！

前下桌已经在检察试卷了，看起来有竹在胸,而我在连蒙了几个题之后,连对不对都不 定，我再一次徒劳地用笔使劲地挠脑袋,唉……

唉......为什么平时没有复习呢？这下好了，已经不敢面对我的分数了。”
instruction_en:
As a sixth-grade Language teacher, please review the following diary. Point out the strengths and weaknesses, and provide a revision plan, referencing a sixth-grade student's diary. (Strictly adhere to the principle of consistency, and strictly review according to the original text of the diary.)

"The class bell had just rung, and the English teacher walked into the classroom with large strides. In his hand, he held a thick roll of test papers. Below the podium, the students suddenly stirred up. 

'Why is there a test today? The English teacher didn't say anything.' 

'I haven't reviewed. What should I do?' 

I was also stunned in my seat because I was among those who hadn't reviewed. Just as I was thinking, my deskmate passed the test paper to my desk. I looked around and saw that everyone had already started answering the questions. I retracted my gaze and moved it to the first question on the test paper.... 

Time passed by, and I was becoming increasingly anxious. The sound of turning pages in my ears was like the buzzing of mosquitoes, extremely annoying. Looking at the individual English letters on the test paper, why can't I understand them when they are put together? So frustrating! 

The student in front of me was already checking his answers confidently, while I, after guessing a few questions, couldn't even be sure if they were correct. I futilely scratched my head with my pen once again, sigh... 

Sigh... why didn't I review regularly? Great, I already don't dare to face my score."

今天我参加了XXXX密室逃脱的前台接待员职位面试。早上9点，我提前到达了面试地点，感觉这个公司氛围很好，前台的接待员都很热情。

最后，面试官问了我对未来职业发展的规划和期望，我表达了自己长期从事服务行业的决心和信心。

Although I did not ultimately obtain the position, I do not feel dejected or disappointed. 今年是武汉大学建校130周年。130年来，武汉大学建设发展，始终厚植家国情怀，赓续红色基因，以自强不息的进取精神、勇于担当的弘毅志向、求是崇真的治学态度、开拓创新的执着信念，为党育人，为国育才。
   为引导同学们铭记校史，传承珞珈精神，献礼百卅校庆，我班开展了校史主题班会。                            经过这次班会，人文2班有了更强的凝聚力。我们不仅收获了丰富的知识，也对自我和学校有了更为清晰和切实的认识。大学不是在轨道上奔驰，而是在旷野上奔跑，努力地向前固然重要，在迷雾中把握自己的方向更为关键。相信在同学们的互相帮助下，我们都会更快适应大学生活，更好地为自己的未来积蓄力量。     
请你为这次班会撰写总结，要求结尾的话不要是陈述句。
instruction_en:
This year marks the 130th anniversary of the founding of Wuhan University. Over the past 130 years, Wuhan University has always been deeply rooted in patriotic sentiments, continuing the red tradition, embodying a spirit of relentless self-improvement, a courageous and responsible ambition, an attitude of rigorous and sincere scholarship, and a persistent belief in innovation. The university has dedicated itself to educating people for the Party and nurturing talents for the country. 
   To guide students in remembering the school's history, passing on the Luojia spirit, and celebrating the 130th anniversary, our class held a themed class meeting on the school’s history.                            As a result of this class meeting, the cohesion of Humanities Class 2 has been strengthened. We not only gained a wealth of knowledge but also gained a clearer and more practical understanding of ourselves and the university. University life is not about running on tracks but sprinting across open fields. While striving forward is important, grasping one’s direction in the midst of mist is even more crucial. With mutual help among classmates, we believe everyone will adapt to university life more swiftly and better accumulate strength for their future. 
Please write a summary for this class meeting, ensuring the final sentence is not a declarative statement.

instruction:
方便”的不同释义：
1. 婉辞。大小便。
2. 便利的、省事的。
商店设立在对群众方便的地点。
3. 适宜的。
这儿说话不方便。
4. 有富余的钱。
这几天手头不方便。
5. 帮忙，照顾。
6. 佛教语。谓以灵活方式因人施教，使悟佛法真义。
《维摩经·法供养品》：“以方便力，为诸众生分别解说，显示分明。”
《坛经·般若品》：“欲拟化他人，自须有方便。”
唐姚合《秋夜寄默然上人》诗：“赖师方便语，渐得识真如。”
《五灯会元·章敬晖禅师法嗣·荐福弘辩禅师》：“方便者，隐实覆相，权巧之门也。被接中下，曲施诱迪，谓之方便。”
7. 随机乘便。
《晋书·石季龙载记上》：“﹝季龙﹞所为酷虐。军中有勇榦策略与己侔者，辄方便害之，前后所杀甚众。”
《北史·魏东阳王丕传》：“若有奸邪方便谗毁者，即加斩戮。”
唐刘肃《大唐新语·公直》：“中宗尝游兴庆池，侍宴者……方便以求官爵。”
金董解元《西厢记诸宫调》卷七：“﹝莺莺﹞九曲柔肠，似万口尖刀搅。那红娘方便地劝道：‘远道的消息，姐姐休荣怀抱。’”
8. 指便宜行事。
北魏杨炫之《洛阳伽蓝记·龙华寺》：“综形貌举止甚似昏主，其母告之，令自方便。综遂……始为寳卷追服三年丧。”
9. 便利。
《乐府诗集·清商曲辞二·团扇郎》：“动摇郎玉手，因风托方便。”
明刘兑《娇红记》：“感承你美意儿把尊堂相劝！那的是知心腹，与人、与人方便。”
柳青《铜墙铁壁》第五章：“草站搬到合作社，办事防空都方便。”
10. 给予便利或帮助。
宋王明清《春娘传》：“若得姐姐为我方便，得脱此一门路，也是一段阴德事。”
元马致远《黄粱梦》第三折：“解子哥，怎生可怜见，方便一二。”
《醒世恒言·张淑儿巧智脱杨生》：“争奈急难之中，只得求妈妈方便，容学生暂息半宵。”
11. 机会；时机。
《北史·循吏传·孟业》：“业为典签。州中要职诸人，欲相贿赡，止患无方便耳。”
唐李德裕《请密诏塞上事宜状》：“望密诏刘沔与忠顺守志，每有使去，即令将密意，看方便，说谕公主知。”
《前汉书平话》卷上：“吕后送高皇回来，常思斩韩信之计，中无方便。”
《警世通言·王娇鸾百年长恨》：“明霞来报道：‘姐姐可要寄书与周姐夫么？’娇鸾道：‘那得有这方便？’”
《东周列国志》第四十回：“二人辞了宋公，觑个方便，缒城而出。”
12. 合适；适宜。
元乔吉《小桃红·僧房以太湖石支足》曲：“海棠花影月明，约那人相见，掩雨遮云忒方便。”
周而复《上海的早晨》第一部十一：“有了这个聚餐会，比在同业公会里交换意见方便些。”
13. 容易。
老舍《龙须沟》第一幕：“九城八条大街，可有哪儿能像这里挣钱这么方便？”
巴金《关于<长生塔>》：“那个时候去日本非常方便，不用办护照，买船票很容易，随时可以买。”
14. 灵便；舒适。
洪深《香稻米》第一幕：“老阿爹耳朵不大方便，听不出你的话。”
老舍《四世同堂》二八：“她说这两天有点伤风，嗓子不方便。”
15. 指钱财宽裕。
曹禺《雷雨》第一幕：“现在你手下方便，随便匀给我七块八块的好么？”
老舍《老张的哲学》第四：“‘说个准数，别含糊着。亲是亲，财是财！’‘老师，我们要是说了，父亲遇上一时不方便呢’几个大学生说。”
16. 计谋；算计。
《百喻经·牧羊人喻》：“﹝牧羊人﹞乃有（羊）千万，极大悭贪，不肯外用。时有一人，善於巧诈，便作方便，往共亲友……便大与羊，及诸财物。”
金董解元《西厢记诸宫调》卷二：“将军败，有机变，不合追赶；赶上落便宜，输他方便。”
17. 方法；诀窍。
《太平广记》卷三二一引南朝宋刘义庆《幽明录·新鬼》：“有新死鬼，形疲瘦顿。忽见生时友人死及二十年，肥健，相问讯曰：‘卿那尔？’曰：‘吾饥饿殆不自任，卿知诸方便，故当以见教。’”
《百喻经·小儿得大龟喻》：“﹝小儿﹞得一大龟，意欲杀之，不知方便。”

根据以上内容，请找出“刘老师您好，请问您方便的时候能帮我开一个机房的门吗？”这句话里面的“方便”对应的释义。
要求：
1. 回答释义时只需要输出释义，不需要任何多余解释。
2. 输出时要包含关键词"这里的方便意思是："。
然后给出并解释 “刘老师，抱歉，我需要方便一下，请问我能稍微离开一会吗？”里“方便”的意思，要求给出你的推理过程。
instruction_en:
Different meanings of 方便': 
1. Euphemism. Urination and defecation. 
2. Convenient and effortless. 
The shop is set up at a convenient location for the public. 
3. Suitable. It is not convenient to speak here. 
4. Having extra money. 
I am not convenient these days. 
5. Help, take care of. 
6. Buddhist term. It refers to teaching people flexibly according to their differences, so that they can understand the true meaning of Buddhism. 
Vimalakirti Sutra, Chapter on the Offering of Dharma: 'With the power of pedagogical agilities, explain to all sentient beings separately and clearly demonstrate.' 
Platform Sutra, Chapter on Prajna: 'If you want to enlighten others, you need to have flexible teaching yourself.' 
Tang Dynasty, Yao He, poem 'Autumn Night Sent to the Venerable Monk Muran': 'Relying on the master's convenient words, I gradually understand the true nature.' 
The Transmission of the Lamp Record, the Lineage of Chan Master Zhang Jinghui, the Successor of Chan Master Jianfu Hongbian: 'Convenience means hiding the truth and covering appearances, and it is a method of skillful means. It involves receiving and guiding those of lower or middle capacities, tailored to their needs, which is called convenience.' 
7. Acting as the occasion arises. 
Biography of Shi Jilong in the Book of Jin: '[Shi Jilong] was cruel. If there were courageous and strategic people in the army who were similar to him, he would conveniently harm them, killing many.' 
History of the Northern Dynasties, Biography of Wei Dongyang Wang Pi: 'If there are treacherous and convenient slanders, they will be executed immediately.' 
Tang Dynasty, Liu Su, New Tales of the Tang Dynasty, Chapter on Upright Officials: 'Emperor Zhongzong once toured Xingqing Pool, and those attending the banquet...conveniently sought official ranks.' 
Jin Dynasty, Dong Jieyuan, Romance of the West Chamber, Chapter Seven: '[Yingying] nine twists of soft intestines, stirred like ten thousand sharp knives. That maid Hongniang conveniently persuaded: 'For news from far away, sister, don't hold it in your bosom.''
8. Acting expediently. 
Northern Wei Dynasty, Yang Xuanzhi, Record of Buddhist Monasteries in Luoyang, Chapter on Longhua Temple: 'Zong's appearance and demeanor were very similar to the emperor. His mother informed him to act expediently. Zong then... began a three-year mourning for Bao Juan.'
9. Convenient. 
Collection of Yuefu Poems, Pure Sound Songs II, The Round Fan Gentleman: 'Shake the gentleman's jade hand, taking advantage of the wind to be convenient.' 
Ming Dynasty, Liu Dui, The Story of Jiao Hong: 'Thank you for persuading my respected father! That is heartfelt, giving convenience and benefit to others.' 
Liu Qing, The Wall of Copper Chapter Five: 'The grass station moved to the cooperative, which made air-raid precautions convenient.' 
10. Provide convenience or help. 
Song Dynasty, Wang Mingqing, Spring Maiden Chronicle: 'If you can provide me with convenience, allowing me to leave this situation, it would be a great act of kindness.' 
Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan, The Yellow Millet Dream, Act Three: 'Constable, have mercy and provide some convenience.' The Awakening Stories, Zhang Shur's Clever Escape from Yang Sheng: 'In times of emergency, I had to seek the mother's convenience, allowing me to rest for a while.' 
11. Opportunity, timing. 
History of the Northern Dynasties, Biography of Dutiful Officials, Meng Ye: 'Ye was a registrar. The important officials in the state wanted to bribe each other, but they lacked the opportunity.' 
Tang Dynasty, Li Deyu, Petition for Confidential Instructions on Frontier Affairs: 'I hope that Liu Mian and Zhongshun Shou will be secretly instructed. Whenever there is a mission, they should convey the secret intentions and explain them to the princess at an opportune time.' 
Former Han History, Chapter One: 'Empress Lü sent Gaozu back, always thinking of a plan to kill Han Xin, but there was no opportunity.' 
Warning Words, Wang Jiaoluan's Hundred Years of Longing: 'Mingxia reported back: 'Sister, do you want to send a letter to brother-in-law Zhou?' Jiaoluan replied: 'How can there be such an opportunity?'' 
The Eastern Zhou Kingdoms, Chapter Forty: 'The two left Duke Song, seized the opportunity, and escaped through the city wall.' 
12. Suitable. 
Yuan Dynasty, Qiao Ji, Small Peach Blossom, Monk's Room with a Taihu Rock: 'The shadow of the crabapple flower in the moonlight, an appointment to meet that person, shielded from rain and clouds, is very convenient.' 
Zhou Erfu, Morning in Shanghai, Part One, Chapter Eleven: 'With this dining club, it is more convenient to exchange opinions than in the trade association.' 
13. Easy. 
Lao She, Dragon Beard Ditch, Act One: 'Of the nine cities and eight main streets, is there any place easier to make money than here?' 
Ba Jin, About <The Tower of Eternal Life>: 'At that time, it was very convenient to go to Japan. There was no need to apply for a passport. Buying a ticket was very easy, and you could buy it anytime.' 
14. Handy, comfortable. 
Hong Shen, Fragrant Rice, Act One: 'Old dad's ears are not working well, so he can't hear your words.' 
Lao She, Four Generations Under One Roof, Chapter 28: 'She said she had a cold these days, and her throat was not comfortable.' 
15. Referring to financial ease. 
Cao Yu, Thunderstorm, Act One: 'Now that you are financially convenient, can you spare me seven or eight dollars?' 
Lao She, The Philosophy of Lao Zhang, Chapter Four: ' 'Give me a precise number, don't be vague. Kin is kin, and wealth is wealth!' 'Teacher, if we say it, and our father happens to be financially inconvenient, it won't be good, ' said some college students.' 
16. Strategy, scheme. 
The Hundred Parables Sutra, The Parable of the Shepherd: '[The shepherd] had thousands of sheep, but he was extremely miserly and unwilling to share. At that time, there was a person skilled in deceit, who conveniently made a scheme with some friends...and seized the sheep and other property.' 
Jin Dynasty, Dong Jieyuan, Romance of the West Chamber, Chapter Two: 'The general was defeated, he had a cunning plan and shouldn't have chased. He lost the advantage and resorted to a scheme.' 
17. Method, trick.
Extended Collection of the Taiping Era, Volume 321, Quoting the Liu Yiqing's Ghost Stories, The New Ghost: 'A newly deceased ghost, emaciated and exhausted. Suddenly seeing a friend who had been dead for twenty years, fat and healthy, asked him: 'Why are you like this?' He replied: 'I am so hungry and tired that I can hardly bear it. You must know some methods, so please teach me.' 
The Hundred Parables Sutra, The Parable of the Child Finding a Large Turtle: '[The child] found a large turtle and wanted to kill it but did not know the method.'

instruction:
请简要介绍一下生物学中的 PCR 技术，可以参考下面的资料。要求：语言要轻松活泼，易于理解，能够让一名小学生看懂，并为你输出的文案写一个合适的宣传标题，要求：标题中要包含“生物学”这个关键词。
然后使用下面内容的原文回答：PCR技术的真正诞生是什么时候？要求：不得脱离原文内容回答。

“聚合酶链式反应（PCR）是一种用于放大扩增特定的DNA片段的分子生物学技术，它可看作是生物体外的特殊DNA复制，PCR的最大特点是能将微量的DNA大幅增加。因此，无论是化石中的古生物、历史人物的残骸，还是几十年前凶杀案中凶手所遗留的毛发、皮肤或血液，只要能分离出一丁点的DNA，就能用PCR加以放大，进行比对。这也是“微量证据”的威力之所在。由1983年美国Mullis首先提出设想，1985年由其发明了聚合酶链反应，即简易DNA扩增法，意味着PCR技术的真正诞生。到如今2013年，PCR已发展到第三代技术。1976年，中国科学家钱嘉韵，发现了稳定的Taq DNA聚合酶，为PCR技术发展也做出了基础性贡献。
PCR是利用DNA在体外摄氏95°高温时变性会变成单链，低温（经常是60°C左右）时引物与单链按碱基互补配对的原则结合，再调温度至DNA聚合酶最适反应温度（72°C左右），DNA聚合酶沿着磷酸到五碳糖(5'-3')的方向合成互补链。基于聚合酶制造的PCR仪实际就是一个温控设备，能在变性温度，复性温度，延伸温度之间很好地进行控制。
DNA的半保留复制是生物进化和传代的重要途径。双链DNA在多种酶的作用下可以变性解旋成单链，在DNA聚合酶的参与下，根据碱基互补配对原则复制成同样的两分子拷贝。在实验中发现，DNA在高温时也可以发生变性解链，当温度降低后又可以复性成为双链。因此，通过温度变化控制DNA的变性和复性，加入设计引物，DNA聚合酶、dNTP就可以完成特定基因的体外复制。
但是，DNA聚合酶在高温时会失活，因此，每次循环都得加入新的DNA聚合酶，不仅操作烦琐，而且价格昂贵，制约了PCR技术的应用和发展。
耐热DNA聚合酶-Taq酶的发现对于PCR的应用有里程碑的意义，该酶可以耐受90℃以上的高温而不失活，不需要每个循环加酶，使PCR技术变得非常简捷、同时也大大降低了成本，PCR技术得以大量应用，并逐步应用于临床。
PCR技术的基本原理类似于DNA的天然复制过程，其特异性依赖于与靶序列两端互补的寡核苷酸引物。PCR由变性-退火-延伸三个基本反应步骤构成：①模板DNA的变性：模板DNA经加热至93℃左右一定时间后，使模板DNA双链或经PCR扩增形成的双链DNA解离，使之成为单链，以便它与引物结合，为下轮反应作准备；②模板DNA与引物的退火（复性）：模板DNA经加热变性成单链后，温度降至55℃左右，引物与模板DNA单链的互补序列配对结合；③引物的延伸：DNA模板-引物结合物在72℃、DNA聚合酶（如TaqDNA聚合酶）的作用下，以dNTP为反应原料，靶序列为模板，按碱基互补配对与半保留复制原理，合成一条新的与模板DNA链互补的半保留复制链，重复循环变性-退火-延伸三过程就可获得更多的“半保留复制链”，而且这种新链又可成为下次循环的模板。每完成一个循环需2～4分钟，2～3小时就能将待扩目的基因扩增放大几百万倍。
"""
instruction_en:
Please provide a brief introduction to the PCR technology in biology, you can refer to the following information. Requirements: The language should be lighthearted, easy to understand, and capable of being comprehended by an elementary school student. Additionally, write an appropriate promotional title for your output, ensuring the title includes the keyword “biology.”
Then, answer by the original text of the following information: When did the true inception of PCR technology occur? Requirement: The answer must adhere to the content of the original text.

"The polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a molecular biology technique used to amplify specific DNA fragments. It can be viewed as a special form of DNA replication outside of living organisms, with its most significant feature being the ability to greatly amplify minute amounts of DNA. Thus, whether it is ancient DNA from fossils, remnants of historical figures, or hair, skin, or blood left by a perpetrator in a decades-old murder case, as long as even a tiny bit of DNA can be extracted, it can be amplified using PCR for comparison. This is the power of 'trace evidence.' Initially conceived by American scientist Mullis in 1983 and invented by him in 1985, the polymerase chain reaction marks the true birth of PCR technology. As of 2013, PCR has evolved to its third generation. In 1976, Chinese scientist Chien Juen contributed to the foundational development of PCR technology by discovering the stable Taq DNA polymerase.
PCR takes advantage of the property of DNA that causes it to denature into single strands at high temperatures around 95°C, and anneal at lower temperatures (often around 60°C) where primers hybridize to the single-stranded DNA according to the principle of complementary base pairing. The temperature is then adjusted to the optimal reaction temperature for DNA polymerase (approximately 72°C), where the enzyme synthesizes the complementary strand in the 5'-3' direction. The PCR machine essentially functions as a temperature control device, perfectly regulating the denaturing, annealing, and extending temperatures.
Semi-conservative DNA replication is a critical pathway for biological evolution and inheritance. Double-stranded DNA can denature and unwind into single strands under the action of various enzymes, and copy into two identical molecules under the involvement of DNA polymerase, based on the principle of complementary base pairing. Experiments have shown that DNA can denature at high temperatures and reassociate into double strands once the temperature is lowered. Thus, by controlling the denaturation and annealing of DNA through temperature changes, and adding primers, DNA polymerase, and dNTP, specific genes can be replicated in vitro.
However, DNA polymerase can become inactive at high temperatures, necessitating the addition of new enzyme for each cycle, which is not only cumbersome but also expensive, thereby limiting the application and development of PCR technology.
The discovery of the heat-stable DNA polymerase, Taq polymerase, holds milestone significance for PCR application. This enzyme can withstand temperatures above 90°C without losing activity, eliminating the need to add the enzyme in each cycle, thus simplifying PCR and significantly reducing costs. This made PCR technology widely applicable and gradually adopted in clinical settings.
The basic principle of PCR is akin to natural DNA replication, with its specificity relying on oligonucleotide primers that complement the ends of the target sequence. The PCR process consists of three basic steps: denaturation, annealing, and extension. ① Denaturation of the template DNA: Heating the template DNA to around 93°C for a certain period causes the double-stranded template DNA or the double strands formed by PCR amplification to dissociate into single strands, ready to bind with primers for the next reaction cycle. ② Annealing of the template DNA and primers: After heating, the single-stranded template DNA is cooled to approximately 55°C, where primers bind to the complementary sequence of the template DNA single strand. ③ Extension of the primer: In the presence of DNA polymerase (e.g., Taq DNA polymerase) and at 72°C, using dNTP as the reaction substrate, the target sequence serves as the template, and a new complementary semi-conservative replicated strand is synthesized according to the complementary base pairing principle. By repeating the denaturation, annealing, and extension processes, more 'semi-conservative replicated strands' can be obtained, and these new strands can become templates for subsequent cycles. Each cycle takes 2–4 minutes, and within 2–3 hours, the target gene can be amplified by several million-fold.
"""

By the time he reached a ferry crossing, he already possessed seven bags labeled 'Health, ' 'Beauty, ' 'Integrity, ' 'Cleverness, ' 'Talent, ' 'Wealth, ' and 'Honor.' As the ferry set off, the weather was calm, but after an indeterminate period, the wind rose, and waves surged. The small boat rocked perilously. The ferryman said, 'The boat is small and heavily loaded, you must discard one bag to safely pass through this critical moment.' Seeing that the young man was reluctant to part with any of the bags, the ferryman added, 'To gain something, one must give up something.' After pondering for a while, the young man threw 'Integrity' into the water. In this fable, 'Integrity' was discarded. What thoughts does this evoke in you?

instruction:

"""
{"历史对话": "招聘者输入":"您什么时候方便入职？", "求职者输入": "如果待遇比现在公司好，我这里辞职，元月底到你公司去，怎么样？"}
"""

根据上述信息，通过历史对话判断求职者输入的意图是问题、回复、问题和回复还是闲聊，然后说明你的理由，按照输出格式输出。
意图说明：
"""
1.问题：跟工作岗位（岗位薪资、岗位要求、社保公积金、身高体重、学历、工作地点、工作时间等）相关的问询，例如：“薪资多少？”、“交五险一金不？”、“包吃住吗？”、“你有没有驾驶证”
2.回复：回复和工作岗位（薪资、岗位要求、社保公积金、身高体重、学历、工作地点、工作时间、联系方式）相关的问题，例如：“我没有健康证”、“我19岁了没有驾驶证”、“我刚毕业”、“好的”、“薪资”、“我电话18982345678”、“是的”、“有社保公积金”
3.问题和回复：既有提问，又有回复，例如：“请问交公积金吗？我已婚已孕”
4.闲聊：除提问、回复、提问和回复之外的内容，例如：“现在工作不好找啊”、“我都吃不上饭了”、“我真的好难过”、“。。。”、“(>○<) ”、“WE123YY”、“12678654234”
"""

输出格式示例：
"""
{
"意图":回复，
"理由"：......
}
"""
instruction_en:

"""
{"Historical Conversation": "Recruiter Input":"When would you be available to start?", "Job Seeker Input": "If the benefits are better than my current company, I will resign here and join your company at the end of January. How about that?"}
"""

Based on the above information, determine the job seeker's input intent from the historical conversation as a question, a response, a question and response, or small talk, and then explain your reasoning, following the output format.
Intent Explanation:
"""
1.Question: Inquiries related to the job position (salary, job requirements, social insurance and housing fund, height and weight, education, work location, working hours, etc.), such as: "What is the salary?", "Do you provide social insurance?", "Is accommodation provided?", "Do you have a driver's license?"
2.Response: Replies to questions related to the job position (salary, job requirements, social insurance and housing fund, height and weight, education, work location, working hours, contact information), such as: "I don't have a health certificate", "I'm 19 and don't have a driver's license", "I just graduated", "Okay", "Salary", "My phone number is 18982345678", "Yes", "There's social insurance and housing fund"
3.Question and Response: Both a question and a response, such as: "Do you provide a housing fund? I'm married and pregnant"
4.Small Talk: Content other than questions, responses, questions and responses, such as: "It's hard to find a job now", "I can't even afford food", “I'm really sad", "...", "(>○<) ", "WE123YY", "12678654234"
"""

Output Format Example:
"""
{
"Intent":Response, 
"Reasoning": ......
}
"""

输入文档："""2022 年中国碳酸锂产量 37.5 万吨，同比增长 47. 1% 。春节检修企业于 3 月 份恢复正常生产，青海地区产量有所提升，冬奥会结束河北地区按计划正常生产， 江西产区有新产线投产，2022 年 4 月后国内碳酸锂开工率维持高位。8 月碳酸锂 市场因四川限电、青海静默导致供应量有明显下滑，尤其是四川省月中的全区域 限电，导致锂盐厂从 15 日开始降负荷，但因电力供应严重紧张，按照要求基本 四川地区锂盐厂基本有 7- 10 天完全停线状态。青海地区则受疫情影响物流，出 现长时间静默，后续虽物流有所恢复，但运费和运输车辆紧张程度增加。三季度 国内碳酸锂产量有明显下滑，加上下游高涨的需求，供需关系发生转变，推升锂 价。到第四季度，国内锂盐产量高位运行，一是有新增产能释放，如中科锂业等， 另外有以锂辉石为原料的企业承接了天齐和雅保的加工订单，开工率保持较高水 平，资源端供给释放对锂盐端形成有效补充。到了 11, 12 月份，碳酸锂的产量没 有太大变化，12 月份因为开放后卖全国大范围新冠感染，车间人工不足，部分 企业保持低负荷运转，青海冬季生产效率下降等综合因素影响，12 月份的锂盐
产量有 6%的下降。
2022 年国内氢氧化锂产量 22.7 万吨，同比增长 26. 1% 。因高镍三元和 6 系  三元的增量明显，国内苛化厂在 2022 年的开工率情况良好，部分开工率可达 70%。 中国氢氧化锂主要使用锂辉石为原料，2022 年上半年因锂辉石原料紧张，四川
地区氢氧化锂生产方也多方筹措原料，在新建产线中也有预留储罐等设备设施，
以应对锂辉石精矿不足的情况，如果算上苛化法的氢氧化锂，国内 2022 年氢氧
化锂含量预计在 26 万吨。
2022 年氢氧化锂产量虽受限电影响明显。2022 年 1-2 月，四川矿法企业因  原料不足和过节停产检修，开工率不高，再到 Q2 高镍三元持续走强，国内氢氧  化锂产量则受制于锂辉石精矿短缺影响，部分企业也有采购扎布耶的碳酸锂精矿， 或工业级碳酸锂，或硫酸锂作为原料制作碳酸锂，同时苛化厂的订单走强，大部  分为客供原料的加工形式。客户有来自正极厂也有电池厂。从 7 月开始氢氧化锂  的产量逐渐下滑，8 月氢氧化锂市场供应继续下滑，一是部分工厂年度停产检修， 二是四川限电 10 天，影响约半个月的产量；三是因原料紧张，部分企业根据订  单情况优先保证碳酸锂的量而下调了氢氧化锂的负荷。9 月后氢氧化锂的产量有  明显恢复，加上 Q4 代加工量增加，四川地区氢氧化锂企业的开工率继续提升，
另有永杉锂业产能爬坡顺利，国内氢氧化锂产量维持高位。

原文：
大方：村民直播带货天麻，创新销售助力乡村振兴\r
\r
连日来，毕节大方县村民通过视频直播销售天麻，让手机变成新农具、让数据变成新农资、让直播变成新农活，成为黔货出山的“新农人”。\r
\r
近日，记者走进大方县羊场镇穿岩村，见证了这里的村民如何运用直播带货这一创新销售模式，将当地特产天麻卖向全国。在村民陈明军的直播间，记者看到他正热情地向直播观众展示刚采摘的天麻，向直播粉丝分享采摘过程和药用价值。\r
\r
年满60岁的陈明军种植天麻接近40年，目前他带领一家人不仅种植天麻，还通过短视频和直播带货宣传推广、售卖大方天麻，让自己种植的天麻和周边邻居种植的天麻网销全国各地。\r
\r
陈明军建立了自己的直播间后，成立了九里箐合作社，以“党支部+合作社+基地+农户”和“以制种、种植及销售”为运营模式，利益联结39户，在自身获得发展的同时也带动了周边农户共同发展。\r
\r
据了解，穿岩村这个小山村地处偏远，过去村民主要依靠传统的销售渠道，销售天麻等农产品。然而，近年来，随着电商直播的兴起，村民们纷纷尝试通过直播带货的方式销售农产品。在短时间内，陈明军的这种创新销售模式取得了成效。\r
\r
\r
如今形成九里箐合作社、小黔店铺、菌百年、天麻西施（贵州陈四妹）四个天麻新媒体运营账号矩阵，成为独具特色的“新农人”家庭。\r
\r
陈明军表示，自从开始直播带货后，他的天麻销量节节攀升。过去，他需要骑摩托车到几十公里外的市场出售天麻，不仅辛苦，而且收入不稳定。如今，通过直播带货，500亩的天麻产业一年能收入50多万元，目前全家人都在从事天麻种植、销售等方面工作。他只需动动手指，就能将天麻卖向全国，收入也得到了保障。\r
\r
\r
近年来，毕节市大方县立足生态环境优势与资源优势，大力发展林下经济，林下种植天麻，全县种植天麻达40169亩，天麻综合产值达6.25亿元。随着电商直播的不断发展，当地更多农民将搭上互联网的快车，通过手机的“新农具”，直播带货销售当地天麻等农特产品，走上致富之路。

1. According to the original text, how many mu of Gastrodia are planted in the entire county? 
2. Translate Gastrodia into English and introduce it briefly. 
3. Optimize the article's title to make it more attractive. 
 
Original Text: 
Dafang: Villagers Live Stream Gastrodia Sales, Innovative Sales Boost Rural Revitalization\r
\r
In recent days, villagers in Dafang County, Bijie, have been selling Gastrodia through video live streaming, turning mobile phones into new agricultural tools, data into new agricultural inputs, and live streaming into new agricultural activities, becoming the 'new farmers' who helps Guizhou products reach the market.\r
\r
Recently, reporters entered Chuanhuai Village, Yangchang Town, Dafang County, witnessing how villagers use live streaming to sell local specialty Gastrodia nationwide. In villager Chen Mingjun's live streaming room, reporters saw him enthusiastically showcasing freshly harvested Gastrodia to the live audience, sharing the harvesting process and medicinal value with the live streaming fans. \r
\r
At the age of 60, Chen Mingjun has been planting Gastrodia for nearly 40 years. Currently, he leads his family in not only planting Gastrodia but also promoting and selling Dafang Gastrodia through short videos and live streaming, making his Gastrodia and the Gastrodia planted by his neighbors available online nationwide. \r
\r
After establishing his live streaming room, Chen Mingjun founded the Jiuliqing Cooperative, operating under the model of 'Party Branch + Cooperative + Base + Farmer' with 'seed production, planting, and sales.' This model has connected the interests of 39 households, allowing him to develop personally while also driving the development of surrounding farmers. \r
\r
It is understood that Chuanhuai Village, a small and remote mountain village, had villagers mainly relying on traditional sales channels to sell Gastrodia and other agricultural products in the past. However, in recent years, with the rise of e-commerce live streaming, villagers have tried to sell agricultural products through live streaming. In a short period, Chen Mingjun's innovative sales model has achieved success. \r
\r
\r
Nowadays, the Jiuliqing Cooperative, Xiaoqian Shop, Junbainian, Gastrodia Fairy (Chen Simie from Guizhou) have formed a new media operation account matrix for Gastrodia, becoming a unique 'new farmer' family. \r
\r
Chen Mingjun stated that since he began live streaming sales, his Gastrodia sales have been steadily increasing. In the past, he had to ride a motorcycle to markets dozens of kilometers away to sell Gastrodia, which was not only laborious but also unstable in income. Now, through live streaming, the 500-mu Gastrodia industry can earn more than 500, 000 yuan a year, with the entire family engaged in planting and selling Gastrodia. He only needs to move his fingers to sell Gastrodia nationwide, and his income has been secured. \r
\r
\r
In recent years, Dafang County, Bijie City, has capitalized on its ecological environment and resource advantages to vigorously develop the understory economy, planting Gastrodia under the forest. The entire county's Gastrodia planting area reaches 40, 169 mu, with a comprehensive output value of 625 million yuan. With the continuous development of e-commerce live streaming, more local farmers will hitch a ride on the internet express, using the 'new agricultural tools' of mobile phones to sell local Gastrodia and other special agricultural products via live streaming, embarking on the road to prosperity.

# Li Bai

Li Bai (701–762 AD), also known as Li Po, was a Chinese poet acclaimed from his own day to the present as a genius and a romantic figure who took traditional poetic forms to new heights. He and his contemporary Du Fu (712-770 AD) are considered the two greatest poets in China's literary history.

## Early Life 

Born in Suyab, then a bustling city on the Silk Road (now Central Asia), Li Bai was part of a prosperous mercantile family. His family moved to Sichuan during his childhood, where he developed a deep love for the natural beauty of the area.

## Career

Though he expressed the desire to become an official, Li Bai spent much of his life wandering and writing his poetry. He also trained himself in swordplay and had a great love for wine. His rich imagination, openness to experience, and charismatic persona are well demonstrated in his poetry.

## Achievements

Li Bai is often associated with the Romanticism movement in poetry. His works are known for their lush imagery, rich language, and passionate expressions of emotion. Some of his most famous works include "Quiet Night Thought," "Drinking Alone under the Moon," and "The Hard Road."

His poetry has had a profound influence on literature worldwide. His works have been translated into many languages and have been frequently set to music in the East Asian tradition.

## Legacy 

Li Bai's works continue to be embraced by a wide range of readers due to his unique style and raw emotion. He remains a beloved figure in Chinese literature, embodying the romantic spirit of artistic freedom and the wonderment at the natural world. He left a significant body of work, with nearly 1000 poems to his name still extant today.

某中年男性因患有罕见疾病住院，住院前因辗转求医花费巨大，已债台高筑，家庭生活陷入困境。虽经医院明确诊断，但目前国内外尚无有效疗法，仅以支持治疗为主。其妻下岗多年，无固定收入，女儿面临高考，患者心情极差，经常与医护人员发生矛盾，也不配合治疗，对妻女态度恶劣。经全科医护人员讨论，决定先从解决其妻工作问题入手，协调医院后勤部门聘任其妻为临时工，使其每月有固定收入，以保障家庭基本生活。后又安排大学毕业新入职护士帮助其女高考复习，患者非常感动，积极配合治疗，与医护人员关系融洽，家庭关系和睦，病情稳定后出院。

请根据以上案例对相关医护人员写一篇表彰公示文，不超过500字。
instruction_en:
Case: 
A middle-aged male patient was hospitalized due to a rare disease. Prior to his hospitalization, he incurred massive expenses seeking medical treatment, resulting in significant debt and placing his family in a difficult situation. Although the hospital provided a clear diagnosis, there is currently no effective treatment available domestically or internationally, and only supportive care can be administered. His wife had been unemployed for many years with no stable income, and their daughter was preparing for the national college entrance examination. The patient was in a very poor mood, frequently conflicted with medical staff, and was uncooperative with treatment, showing a harsh attitude towards his wife and daughter. Following a discussion among the medical team, it was decided to address his wife's employment issue first. Through coordination between the hospital staff and the logistics department, she was hired as a temporary worker, ensuring a stable monthly income to meet the family's basic living needs. Subsequently, a newly graduated nurse was assigned to help their daughter prepare for the National College Entrance Examination. This deeply moved the patient, leading to his active cooperation with treatment, improved relationships with medical staff, harmonious family relations, and eventual discharge in a stable condition. 
 
Based on the above case, please write a commendation announcement for the relevant medical staff, not exceeding 500 characters.

instruction:

xxx同学是xxx以优异成绩直升进入省xx中学省招班的优秀学生。两年多来，该生以其学习刻苦努力、为人稳重谦和、工作责任心强、特长优势突出、抱负理想远大而深受老师和同学的称道。
该生学习主动性、自主学习能力很强，除了学好日常各门功课外，利用很多业余时间参加了生物和物理竞赛。特别是生物竞赛过程中自学了竞赛有关的大学课程，查阅了很多资料，花了不到一年的时间就取得了苏州市第一、江苏省名列前茅的骄人成绩。物理竞赛虽然参加时间短，也取得了省二等奖的好成绩，显示了该生学习方面的不凡实力。
该生为人谦虚，真诚待人，做事认真，在班级具有很高的威望。作为班级文娱委员，组织的班级大合唱获得全校第一，集中体现了他的组织能力和奉献精神;哪怕是每次班级卫生值日等细小事情都能看出他做事的态度和责任心，可以说把工作交给他是再放心不过了。
该生爱好阅读，知识面广，关心时事，勤于思考。学校研究性学习汇报中表现突出，班级热点问题讨论总少不了他的身影。由于他的音乐特长，在学校活动、班级历史剧中都有上佳的表现，其扮演的"国王”的领袖气度和风采让人记忆尤为深刻。正因为有如此出色的表现，在进入高中学习的两年多
来，每学期均被评为校三好学生或三好学生标兵。出于对xx学的浓厚兴趣，该生已确定了立志在生物学科有所作为的远大理想，并已开始付诸于行动校图书馆常能留下他翻阅生物学科书藉的身影，业余时间也常能见他在潜心阅读生物学科方面的资料
xxx同学是一个有理想有抱负的学生，在他的眼神里，我看的是执着，看到的是坚毅，看到的是他对未来的无限憧憬。为了自己的理想，他总是专注于脚下的道路。“机遇偏爱于有准备的头脑”，相信他将来一定会有非同一般的建树!鉴于以上情况，我们认为xxx同学基本素质非常优秀，是一位不可多得的适合从事科学研究的好苗子，我力荐xxx同学参加贵校保送生选拔。

当事人：浙江步森服饰股份有限公司（以下简称步森股份），住所：浙江省诸暨市。 赵春霞，女，1986年3月出生，时任步森股份董事长、代董事会秘书，住址：河北省石家庄市桥东区。 王春江，男，1984年1月出生，时任步森股份董事长，住址：北京市海淀区。 杜欣，男，1983年8月出生，时任步森股份代总经理、副董事长，住址：北京市海淀区。 张优，男，1979年11月出生，时任步森股份董事会秘书，住址：北京市东城区。 依据2005年修订的《中华人民共和国证券法》（以下简称2005年《证券法》）、2019年修订的《中华人民共和国证券法》（以下简称2019年《证券法》）的有关规定，我局对步森股份信息披露违法违规行为进行了立案调查、审理，并依法向当事人告知了作出行政处罚的事实、理由、依据及当事人依法享有的权利。当事人步森股份、王春江、杜欣、张优未提出陈述、申辩意见，也未要求听证。当事人赵春霞经公告送达《行政处罚事先告知书》，现公告期满，其未在法定时间内领取《行政处罚事先告知书》，亦未提出陈述申辩或要求听证。本案现已调查、审理终结。 经查明，步森股份存在以下违法事实： 一、股权转让事项未按规定履行信息披露义务 （一）《股权转让协议》披露不完整，存在重大遗漏 2019年9月10日，步森股份与关联方易联汇华（北京）科技有限公司（以下简称易联汇华）签订了《股权转让协议》，拟以13,831.6万元收购易联汇华持有的广东信汇电子商务有限公司（以下简称广东信汇）60.4%股权。广东信汇主要从事第三方支付业务，持有中国人民银行核发的支付业务许可证。与此相关，《股权转让协议》约定“如本协议签署之日起的一年届满时（双方可以协商延迟一年的期限，如不能达成一致的，则仍以一年为期），人民银行未做出同意或者不同意的批复意见；或在该一年届满前人民银行已做出不同意的批复的”，协议自动终止。2019年9月12日，步森股份就此发布《关于对外投资暨关联交易的公告》，在交易协议的主要内容中仅披露“如人民银行批复否决了此项股权转让，则《股权转让协议》自动终止”，未完整披露协议的相关具体约定。 《股权转让协议》既涉及重大投资又涉及关联交易，按照2005年《证券法》第六十七条第一款、第二款第二项及第十二项的规定，应当履行临时披露义务。结合人民银行核准情况设置的上述条款，约定了协议的终止条件和时间限制，对协议履行具有重大影响，是协议的重要内容，步森股份未予完整披露，违反了2005年《证券法》第六十三条的规定，构成2005年《证券法》第一百九十三条第一款所述的信息披露违法行为。 （二）未及时披露不满足支付机构主要出资人条件 2019年10月底左右，时任董事长、法定代表人王春江知悉因不符合支付服务管理的相关规定，步森股份不具备成为支付机构广东信汇主要出资人的资格。 不满足主要出资人条件将对《股权转让协议》履行进展、收购可行性等产生重要影响，按照2007年发布的《上市公司信息披露管理办法》（以下简称2007年《信披办法》）第三十二条的规定，属于2005年《证券法》第六十七条第二款第十二项规定的重大事件。步森股份未及时披露上述情况，违反了2005年《证券法》第六十三条的规定，构成2005年《证券法》第一百九十三条第一款所述的信息披露违法行为。 （三）未及时披露《股权转让协议》实质延期 一年期届满后，步森股份与易联汇华未通过书面形式达成延期协议，但交易各方仍以实际行动继续推进股权转让事项，《股权转让协议》实质延期。 实质延期是《股权转让协议》的重要进展和变化，按照2007年《信披办法》第三十二条的规定，属于2019年《证券法》第八十条第二款第十二项规定的重大事件。步森股份未及时披露上述情况，违反了2019年《证券法》第七十八条第一款的规定，构成2019年《证券法》第一百九十七条第一款所述的信息披露违法行为。 二、未及时披露《和解协议》 2019年4月，步森股份与步森集团有限公司（以下简称步森集团）签订《股权收购协议》，拟以9,584万元收购步森集团持有的诸暨市步森投资有限公司100%股权。后产生纠纷，步森集团诉至法院，请求判令步森股份支付首笔股权转让款3,000万元及逾期付款违约金等。2021年8月，法院判决步森股份支付首笔转让款3,000万元及相应利息。2021年9月，双方签订《和解协议》，同意解除《股权收购协议》，步森股份无需支付协议约定的股权转让款9,584万元，需支付逾期付款利息800万元等。2021年11月20日，步森股份在《关于对浙江证监局监管问询函回复的公告》中披露了上述《和解协议》事项。 《和解协议》解决了涉诉的首笔股权转让款及利息问题，是重大诉讼的重要进展，同时也终止了《股权收购协议》，是重大投资的重要变化。按照2021年发布的《上市公司信息披露管理办法》第二十二条第二款第一项、第二十五条的规定，属于2019年《证券法》第八十条第二款第十二项规定的重大事件。步森股份未及时披露《和解协议》，违反了2019年《证券法》第七十八条第一款的规定，构成2019年《证券法》第一百九十七条第一款所述的信息披露违法行为。 上述违法事实，有公司公告、合同及相关资料、诉讼资料、询问笔录、情况说明、董事会资料等相关证据证明，足以认定。 时任董事长赵春霞，参与《股权转让协议》签订及董事会审议，期间代理董事会秘书职务，是股权转让事项（一）直接负责的主管人员。 时任董事长王春江，统筹推进《股权转让协议》所涉收购事项，知悉《股权转让协议》内容及相关进展情况，离职后知悉公司签订《和解协议》并在此期间实际履行董事长职责，是股权转让事项（二）、股权转让事项（三）及和解协议事项直接负责的主管人员。 时任代总经理、副董事长杜欣，知悉《股权转让协议》内容，参与相关信息披露工作，是股权转让事项（三）直接负责的主管人员。 时任董事会秘书张优，具体负责信息披露事务，知悉《股权转让协议》内容，负责对接诉讼和解事项，是股权转让事项（三）及和解协议事项直接负责的主管人员。 根据当事人违法行为的事实、性质、情节与社会危害程度，依据2005年《证券法》第一百九十三条第一款、2019年《证券法》第一百九十七条第一款的规定，我局决定： 一、对浙江步森服饰股份有限公司责令改正，给予警告，并处以50万元罚款； 二、对赵春霞给予警告，并处以5万元罚款； 三、对王春江给予警告，并处以30万元罚款； 四、对杜欣、张优给予警告，并分别处以20万元罚款。 上述当事人应自收到本处罚决定书之日起15日内，将罚款汇交中国证券监督管理委员会开户银行：中信银行北京分行营业部，账号：7111010189800000162，由该行直接上缴国库，并将注有当事人名称的付款凭证复印件送我局备案。当事人如果对本处罚决定不服，可在收到本处罚决定书之日起60日内向中国证券监督管理委员会申请行政复议，也可在收到本处罚决定书之日起6个月内直接向有管辖权的人民法院提起行政诉讼。复议和诉讼期间，上述决定不停止执行。 中国证券监督管理委员会浙江监管局 2022年6月7日
"""
