Original text:"""
Administrative Penalty Decision [2022] No. 27 (Busen Shares, Zhao Chunxia, Wang Chunjiang, Du Xin, Zhang You) Administrative Penalty Decision [2022] No. 27 (Zhao Chunxia, Wang Chunjiang, Du Xin, Zhang You)
Party involved: Zhejiang Busen Clothing Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Busen Co., Ltd.), registered in Zhuji City, Zhejiang Province. Zhao Chunxia, female, born in March 1986, was the Chairman and Acting Secretary of the Board of Directors of Busen Co., Ltd. Her address is Qiaodong District, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province. Wang Chunjiang, male, born in January 1984, was then the chairman of Busen Co., Ltd. His address is Haidian District, Beijing. Du Xin, male, born in August 1983, was the acting general manager and vice chairman of Busen Co., Ltd. His address is Haidian District, Beijing. Zhang You, male, born in November 1979, was the Secretary of the Board of Directors of Busen Co., Ltd. His address is Dongcheng District, Beijing. According to the relevant provisions of the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China revised in 2005 (hereinafter referred to as the "2005 Securities Law") and the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China revised in 2019 (hereinafter referred to as the "2019 Securities Law"), our bureau has launched an investigation and trial into the illegal and irregular disclosure of information by BuSen Shares, and has informed the parties of the facts, reasons, basis, and rights enjoyed by the parties in accordance with the law. The parties involved, Busen Shares, Wang Chunjiang, Du Xin, and Zhang You, did not provide any statements or defense opinions, nor did they request a hearing. The party involved, Zhao Chunxia, has served the "Notice of Administrative Penalty in advance" through public announcement. However, upon the expiration of the announcement period, she has not received the "Notice of Administrative Penalty in advance" within the statutory time, nor has she made any statements or requested a hearing. The investigation and trial of this case have now been concluded. After investigation, it was found that Busen Group had the following illegal facts: 1. Failure to fulfill information disclosure obligations in accordance with regulations regarding equity transfer matters (1) Incomplete disclosure of the "Equity Transfer Agreement" and significant omissions. On September 10, 2019, Busen Group signed an "Equity Transfer Agreement" with its affiliated party Yilinhuihua (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yilinhuihua), intending to acquire 60.4% equity of Guangdong Xinhui E-commerce Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangdong Xinhui) held by Yilinhuihua for 138.316 million yuan. Guangdong M&T is mainly engaged in third-party payment business and holds the payment business license issued by the People's Bank of China. In relation to this, the Equity Transfer Agreement stipulates that "if the People's Bank of China does not give a consent or disagreement by the end of one year from the date of signing this agreement (both parties may negotiate to extend the deadline by one year, and if they cannot reach an agreement, the deadline shall still be one year); or if the People's Bank of China has given a disagreement before the end of that year", the agreement shall automatically terminate. On September 12, 2019, Busen Group issued a notice on external investment and related party transactions, which only disclosed in the main content of the transaction agreement that "if the People's Bank of China approves or rejects this equity transfer, the Equity Transfer Agreement will automatically terminate", without fully disclosing the relevant specific provisions of the agreement. The Equity Transfer Agreement involves both significant investments and related party transactions. According to Article 67 (1), (2), (2), and (12) of the 2005 Securities Law, temporary disclosure obligations should be fulfilled. Based on the approval of the People's Bank of China, the above provisions stipulate the termination conditions and time limit of the agreement, which has a significant impact on the performance of the agreement and is an important content of the agreement. BuSen Shares did not fully disclose it, which violates the provisions of Article 63 of the 2005 Securities Law and constitutes an illegal act of information disclosure under Article 193 (1) of the 2005 Securities Law. （2） By the end of October 2019, Wang Chunjiang, the then chairman and legal representative, was informed that due to non-compliance with relevant regulations on payment service management, Busen Group did not have the qualifications to become a major investor in Guangdong Xinhui, a payment institution, as it did not disclose in a timely manner that did not meet the conditions for being a major investor. Failure to meet the requirements of the main investor will have a significant impact on the progress of the implementation of the Equity Transfer Agreement, the feasibility of the acquisition, etc. According to Article 32 of the "Management Measures for Information Disclosure of Listed Companies" (hereinafter referred to as the "2007 Information Disclosure Measures") issued in 2007, it is a major event as stipulated in Article 67 (2) (12) of the Securities Law of 2005. BuSen Corporation's failure to disclose the above situation in a timely manner violates Article 63 of the 2005 Securities Law and constitutes an illegal act of information disclosure under Article 193 (1) of the 2005 Securities Law. （3） After the one-year substantive extension of the Equity Transfer Agreement was not disclosed in a timely manner, BuSen Shares and Yilian Huihua did not reach a written extension agreement, but the parties to the transaction continued to push forward the equity transfer matters with practical actions, resulting in the substantive extension of the Equity Transfer Agreement. The substantial extension is an important development and change in the Equity Transfer Agreement. According to Article 32 of the 2007 Measures for the Administration of Securities, it belongs to the major events stipulated in Article 80, Paragraph 2, Item 12 of the 2019 Securities Law. BuSen Corporation's failure to disclose the above situation in a timely manner violates the provisions of Article 78 (1) of the 2019 Securities Law and constitutes an illegal act of information disclosure under Article 197 (1) of the 2019 Securities Law. 2. Failure to timely disclose the "Settlement Agreement" In April 2019, Busen Group and Busen Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Busen Group) signed a "Equity Acquisition Agreement", intending to acquire 100% equity of Zhuji Busen Investment Co., Ltd. held by Busen Group for 95.84 million yuan. Subsequently, a dispute arose and BuSen Group filed a lawsuit with the court, requesting that BuSen Shares be ordered to pay the first equity transfer fee of 30 million yuan and a penalty for overdue payment. In August 2021, the court ruled that BuSen Shares should pay the first transfer amount of 30 million yuan and corresponding interest. In September 2021, both parties signed a "Settlement Agreement" and agreed to terminate the "Equity Acquisition Agreement". BuSen Shares is not required to pay the equity transfer fee of 95.84 million yuan as stipulated in the agreement, but is required to pay overdue payment interest of 8 million yuan. On November 20, 2021, Busen Group disclosed the above-mentioned "Settlement Agreement" matters in the "Announcement on Reply to Regulatory Inquiry Letter from Zhejiang Securities Regulatory Bureau". The Settlement Agreement resolved the issue of the first equity transfer payment and interest involved in the lawsuit, which is an important development in the major litigation. At the same time, it also terminated the Equity Acquisition Agreement, which is an important change in the major investment. According to the provisions of Article 22 (2) (1) and Article 25 of the Management Measures for Information Disclosure of Listed Companies issued in 2021, it belongs to the major events stipulated in Article 80 (2) (12) of the Securities Law of 2019. BuSen Corporation's failure to disclose the Settlement Agreement in a timely manner violates the provisions of Article 78 (1) of the 2019 Securities Law and constitutes an illegal act of information disclosure under Article 197 (1) of the 2019 Securities Law. The above-mentioned illegal facts are supported by relevant evidence such as company announcements, contracts and related materials, litigation materials, interrogation records, situation explanations, and board materials, which are sufficient to determine. Zhao Chunxia, the then chairman, participated in the signing of the "Equity Transfer Agreement" and the deliberation of the board of directors. During this period, she acted as the acting secretary of the board of directors and was directly responsible for the equity transfer matters (1). Wang Chunjiang, the then chairman, was responsible for coordinating and promoting the acquisition matters related to the "Equity Transfer Agreement". He was aware of the content and related progress of the "Equity Transfer Agreement" and was informed of the company's signing of the "Settlement Agreement" after leaving. During this period, he actually fulfilled the duties of the chairman and was directly in charge of the equity transfer matters (II), equity transfer matters (III), and settlement agreement matters. Du Xin, the then acting general manager and vice chairman, was aware of the content of the Equity Transfer Agreement and participated in the relevant information disclosure work. She was the direct supervisor responsible for the equity transfer matter (III). Zhang You, the then Secretary of the Board of Directors, was specifically responsible for information disclosure affairs, was aware of the contents of the Equity Transfer Agreement, and was responsible for coordinating litigation and settlement matters. He was the direct supervisor responsible for equity transfer matters (III) and settlement agreement matters. Based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of social harm of the illegal behavior of the parties involved, and in accordance with Article 193, Paragraph 1 of the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 197, Paragraph 1 of the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China, our bureau has decided to: 1. order Zhejiang Busen Clothing Co., Ltd. to rectify, give a warning, and impose a fine of 500000 yuan; 2. Give a warning to Zhao Chunxia and impose a fine of 50000 yuan; 3. Give a warning to Wang Chunjiang and impose a fine of 300000 yuan; 4. Give warnings to Du Xin and Zhang You, and impose fines of 200000 yuan each. The above-mentioned parties shall, within 15 days from the date of receipt of this penalty decision, remit the fine to the China Securities Regulatory Commission's bank account: CITIC Bank Beijing Branch Business Department, account number: 711101018980000162, and the bank shall directly hand it over to the national treasury, and send a copy of the payment voucher with the name of the party to our bureau for filing. If the party concerned disagrees with this penalty decision, they may apply for administrative reconsideration to the China Securities Regulatory Commission within 60 days from the date of receiving this penalty decision, or directly file an administrative lawsuit with the competent people's court within 6 months from the date of receiving this penalty decision. During the period of reconsideration and litigation, the above decision shall not be suspended from execution. China Securities Regulatory Commission Zhejiang Regulatory Bureau June 7, 2022

Input Document: """2019 Nonferrous Metal Market Development Report - January 2020 Lithium

January 2020

Chapter 1: Characteristics of Lithium Industry Operation in 2019 and Prospects for 2020

1.1 Characteristics of Industry Operations in 2019

1. In 2019, influenced by policies, supply and demand, and market environment, lithium prices fell below cost prices. The price of lithium salts showed a unilateral downward trend throughout 2019, and the global market entered a fundamental state of oversupply. Coupled with the sharp decline in domestic subsidies, the demand for new energy vehicles in the market sharply decreased, and the price of battery grade lithium carbonate fell below 50000 after entering the third quarter. As of the end of December, the price of battery grade lithium carbonate has dropped from 79500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 49500 yuan/ton, a drop of up to 37.8%; Industrial grade lithium carbonate has dropped from 68500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 39500 yuan/ton, a decrease of 42.4%; Lithium hydroxide decreased from 90500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 48500 yuan/ton, a drop of 46.5%.

2. Since 2015, 70% of the global increase in lithium production has come from mining lithium. From 2015 to 2019, global lithium ore production (in concentrate form) increased significantly from 61000 tons LCE to 258000 tons LCE, while global salt lake lithium production increased from 97000 tons LCE to 178000 tons LCE. Due to the easy replication of the mining process and the rapid increase in production, lithium ore has quickly responded to the global demand growth.

3. The trend of high nickel in power batteries is quietly approaching, and the demand for lithium salts is shifting towards lithium hydroxide. As an important trend in the development of new energy vehicles, European and American car giants with high vehicle positioning, pursuit of long range, and strong technical and safety guarantees will be the first to enter the high nickel era, and they are also the main demand for battery grade lithium hydroxide worldwide. Chinese car companies will become followers in high nickel. From 2020 to 2021, overseas car companies such as Tesla, Volkswagen, and BMW will increase their demand for lithium hydroxide significantly.

4. In 2019, the supply of lithium salts in China increased significantly. According to preliminary statistics from the Lithium Industry Branch, the supply of lithium salts in China increased significantly in 2019. The annual production of lithium carbonate is 150000 tons, an increase of 20% compared to 2018; The annual production of lithium hydroxide is about 90000, a year-on-year increase of 110%; The total domestic production of lithium salts exceeded 230000 tons, a year-on-year increase of 40%, accounting for more than 65% of the global total production. China has become the world's largest producer of lithium salts.

5. The annual sales of new energy vehicles were lower than last year, and the installed capacity of power batteries increased by 9.2% year-on-year. According to data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, in 2019, the cumulative production and sales of new energy vehicles reached 1.242 million and 1.206 million respectively, a year-on-year decrease of 2.3% and 4.0%, respectively. In 2019, new energy experienced a significant decline in the second half of the year due to the impact of subsidy reduction. From January to December 2019, the cumulative installed capacity of power batteries in China reached 62.2 GWh, a year-on-year increase of 9.2%.

6. There is a temporary surplus of supply and demand in the Chinese lithium market. In 2019, China's lithium salt supply reached 227000 tons, with consumption increasing to 185900 tons and net exports of 28600 tons, resulting in a surplus supply of 12500 tons. Positive electrode materials and battery manufacturers have accumulated a large amount of inventory, and the global lithium resource development project process has accelerated this year. In addition, the policy impact on consumer growth this year has not met expectations, resulting in a temporary surplus in the lithium market.

1.2 Market Forecast for 2019

1. With the acceleration of the high nickel process, the global demand for lithium hydroxide in lithium batteries will exceed that of lithium carbonate. With the rapid development of the new energy vehicle market, the requirements for vehicle endurance and power battery energy density are becoming increasingly high. Power battery companies are laying out high nickel batteries one after another, and it is expected that the global demand for lithium hydroxide in the power battery market will reach nearly 100000 tons in 2021, surpassing lithium carbonate for the first time.

2. Price returns to rationality. The price of lithium carbonate fluctuated at a low level after hitting bottom in the first quarter or throughout the year. As the price of lithium carbonate drops to the cost line of some lithium extraction enterprises using spodumene, some companies may choose to reduce production and production, and the price of lithium carbonate is expected to stabilize. In terms of lithium hydroxide, the entry of foreign car companies such as Tesla, BMW, and Volkswagen into China next year may boost demand for high nickel. In 2019, the high-quality production capacity of domestic battery grade lithium hydroxide was relatively limited. 3. In 2020, subsidies for new energy vehicles will not continue to decline, and the development of new energy vehicles will continue to improve in the long run. Input Document: """2019 Nonferrous Metal Market Development Report - January 2020 Lithium

January 2020

Chapter 1: Characteristics of Lithium Industry Operation in 2019 and Prospects for 2020

1.1 Characteristics of Industry Operations in 2019

1. In 2019, influenced by policies, supply and demand, and market environment, lithium prices fell below cost prices. The price of lithium salts showed a unilateral downward trend throughout 2019, and the global market entered a fundamental state of oversupply. Coupled with the sharp decline in domestic subsidies, the demand for new energy vehicles in the market sharply decreased, and the price of battery grade lithium carbonate fell below 50000 after entering the third quarter. As of the end of December, the price of battery grade lithium carbonate has dropped from 79500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 49500 yuan/ton, a drop of up to 37.8%; Industrial grade lithium carbonate has dropped from 68500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 39500 yuan/ton, a decrease of 42.4%; Lithium hydroxide decreased from 90500 yuan/ton at the beginning of the year to 48500 yuan/ton, a drop of 46.5%.

2. Since 2015, 70% of the global increase in lithium production has come from mining lithium. From 2015 to 2019, global lithium ore production (in concentrate form) increased significantly from 61000 tons LCE to 258000 tons LCE, while global salt lake lithium production increased from 97000 tons LCE to 178000 tons LCE. Due to the easy replication of the mining process and the rapid increase in production, lithium ore has quickly responded to the global demand growth.

3. The trend of high nickel in power batteries is quietly approaching, and the demand for lithium salts is shifting towards lithium hydroxide. As an important trend in the development of new energy vehicles, European and American car giants with high vehicle positioning, pursuit of long range, and strong technical and safety guarantees will be the first to enter the high nickel era, and they are also the main demand for battery grade lithium hydroxide worldwide. Chinese car companies will become followers in high nickel. From 2020 to 2021, overseas car companies such as Tesla, Volkswagen, and BMW will increase their demand for lithium hydroxide significantly.

4. In 2019, the supply of lithium salts in China increased significantly. According to preliminary statistics from the Lithium Industry Branch, the supply of lithium salts in China increased significantly in 2019. The annual production of lithium carbonate is 150000 tons, an increase of 20% compared to 2018; The annual production of lithium hydroxide is about 90000, a year-on-year increase of 110%; The total domestic production of lithium salts exceeded 230000 tons, a year-on-year increase of 40%, accounting for more than 65% of the global total production. China has become the world's largest producer of lithium salts.

5. The annual sales of new energy vehicles were lower than last year, and the installed capacity of power batteries increased by 9.2% year-on-year. According to data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, in 2019, the cumulative production and sales of new energy vehicles reached 1.242 million and 1.206 million respectively, a year-on-year decrease of 2.3% and 4.0%, respectively. In 2019, new energy experienced a significant decline in the second half of the year due to the impact of subsidy reduction. From January to December 2019, the cumulative installed capacity of power batteries in China reached 62.2 GWh, a year-on-year increase of 9.2%.

6. There is a temporary surplus of supply and demand in the Chinese lithium market. 在石油天然气压力输送管道中，为了保证管道的安全运行，焊缝的质量至关重要。焊缝质量主要取决于焊接工艺、焊接操作人员和焊接材料。因为选用16MnR为管道材料，所以钢材的特性选择的焊接方法为氩弧焊，埋弧焊，手工电弧焊等。

根据《天然气集输管道施工及验收规范》（GB 50257-2015）和相关标准，我国石油天然气压力管道的焊缝质量验收标准如下：

（1）外观检查：焊缝表面应光滑、整齐，无毛刺、焊渣、焊疤、裂纹、气孔、夹渣等缺陷。焊缝与母材过渡应自然，无明显的焊缝突起和焊趾凹陷。

（2）焊缝尺寸：焊缝高度、宽度、长度等尺寸应符合设计文件和规范要求。

（3）焊接工艺评定：焊接工艺评定应符合相关标准要求，以确保焊接质量符合设计要求。

（4）无损检测：根据管道设计压力、材料类别和焊接方法等，选择合适射线检测，对焊缝质量进行检验。对接焊缝应进行 100% 的射线探伤，以确保焊接质量。

（5）焊缝内部质量：通过射线检测，确保焊缝内部无裂纹、气孔、夹渣等缺陷。

（6）焊缝力学性能：对焊缝进行拉伸、弯曲、冲击等性能试验，确保其力学性能满足设计要求。

（7）焊缝腐蚀性能：对焊缝进行腐蚀试验，确保其腐蚀性能满足设计要求。

（8）热处理和硬度检测：对焊接完毕的管道进行热处理和硬度检测，确保焊缝性能满足设计要求。

（9）质量记录和人员资格：确保焊接过程的质量记录完整，包括焊接工艺评定、焊工资格、焊接材料等。同时，焊工、无损检测人员、质量检验人员等应具备相应的资格证书。

（10）验收程序：焊接质量验收应按照相关程序进行，包括初检、复检、终检等环节。验收结果应记录在验收报告中，并经相关部门签字确认。

In petroleum and natural gas pressure transmission pipelines, to ensure the safe operation of the pipeline, the quality of the weld seam is crucial. The quality of the weld seam mainly depends on the welding process, welding operators, and welding materials. Because 16MnR is selected as the pipeline material, the welding methods chosen based on the material characteristics include argon arc welding, submerged arc welding, and manual arc welding.

According to the 'Code for Construction and Acceptance of Natural Gas Gathering and Transportation Pipelines' (GB 50257-2015) and relevant standards, the weld seam quality acceptance criteria for China's petroleum and natural gas pressure pipelines are as follows:

(1) Visual Inspection: The weld seam surface should be smooth and neat, without burrs, welding slag, welding scars, cracks, pores, slag inclusions, and other defects. The transition between the weld seam and the base material should be natural, without obvious weld seam protrusions and weld toe depressions.

(2) Weld Seam Dimensions: The height, width, length, and other dimensions of the weld seam should meet the requirements of the design documents and specifications.

(3) Welding Procedure Qualification: The welding procedure qualification should meet the relevant standard requirements to ensure that the welding quality meets the design requirements.

(4) Nondestructive Testing: According to pipeline design pressure, material type, and welding method, appropriate radiographic testing should be selected to inspect the quality of the weld seam. Butt weld seams should undergo 100% radiographic testing to ensure welding quality.

(5) Internal Quality of Weld Seam: Through radiographic testing, ensure that the internal part of the weld seam is free from cracks, pores, slag inclusions, and other defects.

(6) Mechanical Properties of Weld Seam: Perform tensile, bending, impact, and other performance tests on the weld seam to ensure its mechanical properties meet the design requirements.

(7) Corrosion Performance of Weld Seam: Conduct corrosion tests on the weld seam to ensure its corrosion performance meets the design requirements.

(8) Heat Treatment and Hardness Testing: Perform heat treatment and hardness testing on the welded pipeline to ensure that the welding performance meets the design requirements.

(9) Quality Records and Personnel Qualifications: Ensure the quality records of the welding process are complete, including welding procedure qualifications, welder qualifications, welding materials, etc. Additionally, welders, nondestructive testing personnel, and quality inspectors should hold the corresponding qualification certificates.

(10) Acceptance Procedures: The welding quality acceptance should be carried out according to the relevant procedures, including initial inspection, re-inspection, and final inspection stages. The acceptance results should be recorded in the acceptance report and signed by the relevant departments.

instruction:

然后在提取出这一方法后将这一方法翻译为英文输出。

参考资料：
"""
基于高斯场和调和函数的半监督学习是一种机器学习方法，旨在利用标记和未标记数据来进行分类或回归任务。这种方法利用了高斯场理论和调和函数的性质，以实现对未标记数据的有效利用。
具体来说，这种方法首先将数据表示为一个图结构，其中节点代表样本，边代表它们之间的关系或相似度。然后，通过在这个图上定义高斯场，将标记数据的信息传播到未标记数据上。高斯场的参数通常通过最大化似然函数或正则化来学习。调和函数在这个方法中扮演了重要角色，它们被用来在图结构上定义平滑性，以确保在学习过程中相邻节点的输出相似。通过最小化预测标签之间的差异和数据的平滑性之间的权衡，可以实现对未标记数据的准确预测。
基于高斯场和调和函数的半监督学习是一种强大的技术，可以有效地利用未标记数据，提高分类或回归任务的性能。
"""
instruction_en:
Please first extract the machine learning method primarily explained in the reference material, including the keyword "Primarily explained:". After extracting this method, translate this method into English. 

Reference material: 
"""
Semi-supervised learning based on Gaussian fields and harmonic functions is a machine learning method aimed at utilizing both labeled and unlabeled data for classification or regression tasks. This method leverages the properties of Gaussian field theory and harmonic functions to effectively utilize unlabeled data. 
Specifically, this method first represents the data as a graph structure, where nodes represent samples and edges represent their relationships or similarities. Then, by defining a Gaussian field on this graph, the information from the labeled data is propagated to the unlabeled data. The parameters of the Gaussian field are typically learned through maximum likelihood estimation or regularization. Harmonic functions play a crucial role in this method, they are used to define smoothness on the graph structure to ensure that the outputs of adjacent nodes are similar during the learning process. By balancing the difference between predictive labels and the smoothness of the data, accurate predictions for unlabeled data can be achieved. 
Semi-supervised learning based on Gaussian fields and harmonic functions is a powerful technique that can effectively utilize unlabeled data, thereby enhancing the performance of classification or regression tasks.
"""

instruction:
有一句诗：“寂寞空庭春欲晚，梨花满地不开门”。
请先给出这句诗的出处和作者。
然后根据所给的参考资料生成一个和这首诗相关的文言文小故事。要求：1. 生成的故事内容不要使用参考资料之外的其他内容。

参考资料：
"""
这是一首宫怨诗，原文是“纱窗日落渐黄昏，金屋无人见泪痕。寂寞空庭春欲晚，梨花满地不开门。”第二句直接点破主题。诗人化用汉武帝幼时愿以金屋藏阿娇的典故，点明地点是与世隔绝的深宫，人物是幽闭于宫中的少女。而“无人见泪痕”五字，或有两个含义：一是其人因独处一室、无人相伴而不禁潸然泪下；二是其人身处极度孤寂的环境下，即便落泪也无人看见，无人同情。这正是宫人的命运最可悲之处。“泪痕”两字，也值得细细玩味。泪下而留下痕迹，可见其流泪已有多时。诗人仅用七个字，便把诗中人的身份、处境与怨情都写出来了。这句是全诗的中心，其他三句都是围绕这一句、烘托这一句而写的。

起句，使得无人的“金屋”更显凄凉。屋内环顾并无一人，诚然已经非常凄凉，但是在阳光照射下，或许可以削减几分凄凉。但屋中光线随着纱窗日落、黄昏临近而越来越昏暗，其凄凉况味就可想而知了。

第三句，为无人的“金屋”更添孤寂之感。屋内无人，诚然使人感到孤寂，若是屋外人声喧闹，春色正浓，呈现出一片生机盎然之景，或许也可以削减几分孤寂。而现在，院中空无一人，又是花事已了的晚春时节，这就使得“金屋”中人更加感到孤寂难堪了。

末句，不仅直承上句，是“春欲晚”的补充和引伸；也遥应次句，对诗中之人起了陪衬作用。王夫之表示“诗文俱有主宾”，要“立一主以待宾”。而这首诗中所立之主便是次句的“金屋”中人，所待之宾就是这句的梨花，以宾陪主，使得人泣与花落相互映衬。

从时间布局来看，首句是写时间之晚，第三句是写季节之晚。从首句的纱窗日暮，引出第二句的窗内独处之人；从第三句空庭春晚，引出末句庭中的飘落之花。

从空间布局来看，前两句写屋内，后两句写院中。由内及外，由近及远，从屋内的黄昏渐临到屋外的春晚花落，从近处的杳无一人到远处的庭空门掩。一位少女身处于这样凄凉孤寂的环境中，自然是注定要以泪洗面了。

从色彩的点染来看，开头就使得景物都笼罩在暮色中，为全诗涂上了一层暗淡的底色，接着在这底色上映衬以洁白炫目的满地梨花，进而烘托出一个特定的环境气氛与主人公的伤春情绪，全诗的色调与情调一致。

为了增加画面的效果，深化全诗的意境，诗人还运用了重叠渲染、反复勾勒的手法。诗中，写完日落，又写黄昏，使得暮色更加昏暗；写完春晚，又写落花满地，使得春色扫地无余；写完金屋无人，又写庭院空寂，再写重门深掩，把诗中之人无依无伴、与世隔绝的悲惨境地刻画到了无以复加的地步。以上这些，都是加重分量的写法，都是为了衬托出女子的怨情而着意描绘了那样一个凄凉寂寞的境界。

此外，本诗在层层烘托诗中人怨情的同时，还使用象征的手法暗示了美人迟暮之感，进一步显示出诗中人身世的可悲、青春的暗逝。“日落”、“黄昏”、“春欲晚”、“梨花满地”，都象征了诗中人的命运，作为诗中人的影子来写的，都使得本诗更加深曲委婉，味外有味。
"""
instruction_en:
There is a line of poetry: 'Lonely courtyard in late spring, pear blossoms cover the ground without opening the door.' 
Please first provide the source and author of this line of poetry. 
Then, generate a Classical Chinese short story related to this poem based on the provided reference material. Requirement: 1. The generated story content should not use anything other than the provided reference material. 

Reference Material: 
"""
This is a poem expressing the resentment of court life, the original text is 'Sasame screens, sunset fades to twilight, golden house with no one to see the tear stains. Lonely courtyard in late spring, pear blossoms cover the ground without opening the door.' The second line directly reveals the theme. The poet uses the anecdote of Emperor Wu of Han wishing to sequester his beloved in the golden house to indicate the isolated deep palace, with the character being a young girl confined within. The phrase 'no one to see the tear stains' might have two meanings: one is that she sheds tears because she is alone with no one to accompany her, the other is that she exists in an extremely lonely environment, and even if she cries, no one notices or sympathizes. This is the most poignant fate of palace women. The words 'tear stains' are also worth pondering deeply. The tear stains imply that she has been crying for a long time. The poet, with just seven characters, reveals the character's identity, situation, and resentment. This line is the core of the poem, around which the other three lines are written for emphasis. 

The opening line makes the 'golden house' with no one appear even more desolate. Looking around inside, there is not a single person, which is indeed very desolate, but sunlight might slightly reduce the desolation. However, as dusk approaches, the light in the room dims through the sasame screens, and the desolation is exacerbated. 

The third line adds to the loneliness of the 'golden house'. An empty house indeed feels lonely, but if there were bustling sounds outside and the spring scene were vibrant and full of life, it might lessen the loneliness. But now, the courtyard is empty, and it is the late spring season when flowers have withered, making the 'golden house' even more unbearable in its loneliness. 

The final line not only follows on from the preceding line, extending the theme of 'late spring', but also echoes the second line, providing a contrast to the character within the poem. Wang Fuzhi stated, 'Poetry and prose both have a host and a guest', establishing a main character to be accompanied by a guest. The main character in this poem is the person in the 'golden house' in the second line, and the guest is the pear blossoms in the final line, complementing the main character with the image of falling blossoms, emphasizing the mutual reflection of tears and falling flowers. 

From the time perspective, the opening line describes late time, the third line describes late season. From the twilight at the sasame screens in the first line, leading to the solitary person inside the screen in the second line, from the empty courtyard in late spring in the third line, leading to the falling blossoms in the courtyard in the final line. 

From the spatial perspective, the first two lines describe the interior, the latter two lines describe the exterior. From inside to outside, from near to far, from the twilight gathering inside the room to the falling blossoms in the courtyard outside, from the emptiness inside to the deserted courtyard with closed doors. A young girl in such a desolate and lonely environment is naturally destined to wash her face with tears. 

From the color perspective, the poem starts by enveloping the scene in the twilight, painting a dim background for the entire poem. Against this backdrop, the dazzling white pear blossoms covering the ground are highlighted, creating a specific atmosphere and highlighting the protagonist's melancholy in spring. The tone and mood of the entire poem are consistent. 

To enhance the visual effect and deepen the whole poem’s artistic conception, the poet employs repetitive and reinforcing techniques. The poem writes about the sunset, then the twilight, making the dusk darker, describes the late spring, then the ground full of fallen blossoms, sweeping away the spring entirely, describes the empty 'golden house', then the desolate courtyard and deeply locked doors, depicting the character’s isolated and pitiable situation to the utmost extent. These techniques, adding weight, are deliberately used to highlight the woman's resentment, drawing a poignant and lonely realm. 

Additionally, while gradually emphasizing the character’s resentful emotions, the poem employs symbolic techniques to imply the sense of beauty fading over time, further showing the tragic fate and loss of youth of the character. 'Sunset', 'twilight', 'late spring', 'pear blossoms covering the ground', all symbolize the character's fate, written as her shadow, making the poem even more profound, subtle, and flavorful.
"""

寻找地外生命

人类对地外生命的想象在科幻作品中就可见一斑。

近年来，刘慈欣扬名全球文坛。刘慈欣的代表作品《三体》就讲了一个关于地外生命的故事。刘慈欣的三部曲开始于20世纪60年代末，当时，一位年轻的中国女性向附近的星系发了一条消息，于是收到信息的文明开始了长达数个世纪之久的征程，意在征服地球。在前往地球的途中，地外文明破坏人类世界的粒子加速器，以防人类在物理领域取得进展并增强战力。

实际上，寻找地外生命经常被认为为一种宗教神秘主义，甚至在科学界都如此。这是因为，寻找地外生命源自人类渴望接触和超越的欲望，处理人类起源、自然原初力、这个宇宙的未来等问题。1802年，年轻的德国数学家卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯提出了一个想法——向可能存在的火星人宣告地球文明的存在，具体做法就是将西伯利亚的森林清理出一大片区域，种上小麦，并在此基础上绘制出一个表示毕达哥拉斯定理的巨型图案。

大约80年后，为了向火星人展示人类的存在，天文学家帕西瓦尔·罗威尔建议在撒哈拉沙漠中挖运河。罗威尔是罗威尔天文台的创建者，该天文台位于美国亚利桑那州的弗拉格斯塔夫。他也是火星表面存在运河假说的支持者。他的计划是在挖好的运河中倒入油，然后点燃，从而吸引火星人的注意。尽管这两个想法都没有付诸实践，但却是人类证明先进行星文明存在的宝贵尝试。

人类真正开始搜寻地外文明，是20世纪60年代。彼时，SETI（搜寻地外智慧）的研究在美国兴起。SETI计划假设地外生物正在以足够的功率广播其信号，以便在地球上的人类能够探测到它。不够，虽然我们人类的雷达、无线电和电视广播也向太空发送信号，但这些信号非常微弱，因此，人类使用现有的SETI技术无法探测到来自其他星球的类似信号，除非它们来自离人类很近的星球。

换言之，现在可能也有数以百万计的行星上有着生命的存在，他们散布在宇宙中，而且可能每个行星都有一个与人类一样的SETI探测项目或程序，但谁也没有探测到任何东西。他们可能和人类一样，会问：“大家都在哪里？”

为了使SETI计划获得成功，1971年，NASA号召多位天文学家集思广益，设想哪些技术可以在天空中搜寻SETI信号。他们提出了一个雄心勃勃的“望远镜森林”计划：建造一个由1000架射电望远镜组成的巨大阵列。科学家们希望以此搜寻到通信讯号，尤其是那些在无线电频段上覆盖范围很窄的信号。

和宇宙中自然产生的、以宽波段为主的无线电信号不一样，这样的信号很容易分辨。天文学家希望监测到另一个文明为了吸引宇宙邻居注意而广播的无线电信号，甚至窃听到两个外星文明之间的无线电通信。

虽然这项“望远镜森林”计划最终没能实现，但它成为了SETI项目的基石。1992年10月，在波多黎各和美国加利福尼亚州，两架射电望远镜开始在夜空中搜寻宇宙深处可能来自于外星文明的信号。可惜，仅仅一年后，搜寻工作突然中止，因为一位参议员砍掉了NASA预算里所有用于SETI的资金。

地外生命是否存在，科学上一直是有争论的。如果完全从常识出发来推论，外星文明存在的可能性当然是无法排除的。在外星文明问题上发表过大量作品的卡尔·萨根认为，我们没有理由自诩为空前绝后或最理想的生物：“在宇宙戏剧中，我们不是主角。”一个简单的事实是：至今，人类既没有发现外星文明存在的证据，也未能提供外星文明不存在的证据。

人类走到哪一步？

几十年来，天文学家一直在想方设法提高望远镜的观测能力，寻找可能源自于地外高级文明的信号。直到今天，这种高级信号的探测仍未被证实，但天文学家已经发了几个非常有趣的太空信号。

其中非常有名的是一个长达72秒的 “WOW” 信号，它由俄亥俄州立大学的大耳朵射电望远镜于1977年8月15日探测到。“大耳朵”其实就是就是著名的突破聆听计划——突破聆听计划是历史上规模最大的搜寻地外智慧生命的项目，最初“大耳朵”主要由位于美国西弗吉尼亚州的100米口径的Green Bank射电望远镜和位于澳大利亚的64米口径的Parkes射电望远镜充当。

值得一提的是，有着“中国天眼”之称的500米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）也于2016年加入了突破聆听计划。“中国天眼”于2016年9月建成并完成“初光”，经过三年多的调试和试观测，终于在2020年1月通过国家验收、正式开放运行。目前，“中国天眼”已经开启了地外文明搜索的工作。未来，这些望远镜可能会通过交换观测计划、共享观测数据等方式，更好地完成监听任务。

另一个著名射电信号，简称BLC1，在2019年4月和5月被分别探测到。虽然 “WOW” 信号中包含了诸多地外起源的特征，但类似的信号后来再也没有探测到。BLC1来源于离我们最近的恒星——比临星，目前天文学家仍在分析它。

最近几十年，这一研究领域另一巨大突破是关于系外行星的研究。自1992年首次发现两颗系外行星，天文学家们就开始充分利用开普勒太空望远镜以及其他望远镜，发现了超过4400颗系外行星，还有众多行星候选体等待确认。这些系外行星的物理性质千差万别，从类地行星到超级地球，从类海王星到热木星等等。平均来看，每颗恒星都有一颗环绕其自身运行的行星，其中一些恒星甚至有多颗行星，就像我们的太阳有八颗大行星环绕。

如此之多的系外行星的发现，让天体生物学家们也对遥远行星的生物学信号有了更多好奇。比如，Kepler-22b就是开普勒望远镜发现的一颗可能适宜居住的行星，距离地球大约600光年。根据天文学家的计算，这颗行星的半径大约是地球的2.4倍，且恰好位于它所围绕的那颗恒星的宜居带内。如果Kepler-22b的性质与地球相似，那么，在其地表就可能存在生命生存所必需的液态水，自然也有可能成为一些生命体的家园。

Kepler-186f也是开普勒望远镜的著名发现之一，距离地球大约500光年。Kepler-186f是其所在恒星系中的第五颗行星，体积跟地球相似，且位于所在恒星的宜居带内。另外，根据研究人员的分析，Kepler-186f跟地球类似，转轴倾角似乎也能保持稳定，这表明Kepler-186f也许同样可以定期季节更替。跟地球有这么多相似点，Kepler-186f自然会让人们产生更多的期待。

也许，未来这些行星中的某颗或某几颗会用事实告诉我们，在浩瀚的宇宙中，人类其实并不孤单。

应该拥抱外星文明吗？

虽然当前人类仍在持续对外星文明进行探索，但我们是否应该探索外星文明，又是否应该拥抱外星文明一直是持续争议的一个话题。

毕竟，主张与外星文明接触的科学家们，从20世纪6O年代开始，就推动了一系列SETI（以无线电搜寻地外文明信息）计划和METI（主动向外星发送地球文明信息）计划。这样做的主要理由，是人们幻想地球人类可以通过与外星文明的接触和交往而获得更快的科技进步。

而反对与外星文明交往的观点，则更为理智冷静，更为深思熟虑，也更以人为本，半个多世纪以来西方学者在这方面做过大量的分析和思考。比如以写科幻作品著称的科学家布林（D．Brin）提出猜测说，人类之所以未能发现任何地外文明的踪迹，是因为有一种目前还不为人类所知的危险，让所有其他外星文明都保持沉默——这被称为“大沉默”。在此情形下，人类向外太空发送信息，暴露自己在太空中的位置，就很有可能招致那些侵略性文明的攻击。

不仅如此，对地外文明的探索，还指向了一个更遥远的方向——我们能在宇宙里留下什么？

恐龙在地球上生活了大约1.6亿年。它们为了食物和生存领地而战，想方设法不被捕食者吃掉。和人类一样，它们也会照顾幼崽，并试图保护自己的后代免受捕食者的侵害。恐龙存活了数千万代，但如今，却已经从这个蓝色星球上消失。它们这个物种中无数曾活过的个体是为了什么而活？它们曾经的存在有何意义？一些恐龙物种进化成了今天的鸟类，但大多数已经灭绝。如果人类没有发现恐龙化石，那么浩渺宇宙中很可能没有物种会知道恐龙曾经在地球上存在过。

对于人类来说，没有人知道，人类的明天究竟有多久？如果人类灭绝，以后会有其他物种知道人类曾经存在过，曾经生活在这个蓝色星球上吗？如果他们没有找到人类遗骸，那么人类在科学、艺术、文化和历史上所取得的一切成就都将永远消失，而永远消失就如同从未存在。

但向外星文明的探索无疑给人类留下了存在的痕迹，事实上，就外星文明知道人类的存在这一事实本身就很有价值，这就好像如果我们知道宇宙的其他地方曾有生命存在一样，我们人类会多么激动。

除了我们曾经存在的事实，我们还可以向外星文明介绍人类历史，并向他们传授知识。想象一下，如果恐龙能告诉我们它们是如何生活的，是什么导致了它们灭绝，又会给我们人类带来怎样的启发？并且，因为人类具有的独特智慧，我们还可以告诉外星文明那些比恐龙可以告诉我们的更有价值的东西。

此外，我们或许还有机会记录并传达人类灭绝的原因。比如，如果我们现在能够了解遥远星球上的外星生命是由于自我引起的气候变化而灭绝的，那么我们就会更认真地对待当前的气候状况。了解其他外星生命存在了多久及其灭绝的原因，能帮助我们生存得更久。

人类永远无法精准地预知未来，或许，探索地外生命的意义，比我们想象的还要深刻。
"""

Read the provided reference material. 
First, come up with three debate topics related to the search for extraterrestrial life (do not use any known knowledge or information to answer the questions). 
Then, for each topic, generate two one-sentence supporting arguments and two one-sentence opposing arguments, ensuring all arguments are well-reasoned and logically sound.

Overall requirements: 
- Use Markdown table format for the output with column names ["Debate Topic", "Supporting Arguments", "Opposing Arguments"]. 
- Please answer in English. 

Reference material:
"""
What will the search for extraterrestrial life bring to humanity

In the Milky Way, there are one to two hundred billion stars, and our sun is just one of them; In the entire universe, there are over a billion galaxies, and our Milky Way is just one of them. The vastness of the universe has also inspired human exploration of extraterrestrial life. In fact, since the first discovery of exoplanets, astronomers have been searching for extraterrestrial life.

Although humans have not yet discovered extraterrestrial life, many people firmly believe in its existence. At least a considerable number of scientists have been searching for extraterrestrial life for many years. Today, where has the search for extraterrestrial life reached? What will the search for extraterrestrial life bring to humanity?

Quest for Extraterrestrial Life 

Human imagination of extraterrestrial life can be seen in science fiction works.

In recent years, Liu Cixin has gained fame in the global literary world. Liu Cixin's representative work "The Three Body Problem" tells a story about extraterrestrial life. Liu Cixin's trilogy began in the late 1960s when a young Chinese woman sent a message to a nearby galaxy, and the civilization that received the message embarked on a centuries long journey to conquer Earth. On the way to Earth, extraterrestrial civilizations destroy the particle accelerators of the human world to prevent humans from making progress in the field of physics and enhancing their combat power.

In fact, the search for extraterrestrial life is often considered a form of religious mysticism, even in the scientific community. This is because the search for extraterrestrial life stems from humanity's desire to touch and transcend, to deal with issues such as human origins, natural forces, and the future of this universe. In 1802, young German mathematician Karl Friedrich Gauss proposed an idea to declare the existence of an Earth civilization to potential Martians. The specific method was to clear a large area of Siberian forests, plant wheat, and draw a giant pattern representing the Pythagorean theorem on this basis.

About 80 years later, in order to demonstrate the existence of humans to the Martians, astronomer Perceval Lowell suggested digging a canal in the Sahara Desert. Lowell is the founder of the Lowell Observatory, located in Flagstaff, Arizona, USA. He is also a supporter of the canal hypothesis on the surface of Mars. His plan is to pour oil into the dug canal and ignite it to attract the attention of the Martians. Although neither of these ideas have been put into practice, they are valuable attempts by humanity to prove the existence of advanced planetary civilizations.

Humans truly began searching for extraterrestrial civilizations in the 1960s. At that time, research on SETI (Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence) was on the rise in the United States. The SETI program assumes that extraterrestrial life is broadcasting its signals with sufficient power so that humans on Earth can detect it. Not enough, although our human radar, radio, and television broadcasts also send signals to space, these signals are very weak, so humans cannot detect similar signals from other planets using existing SETI technology unless they come from planets very close to humans.

In other words, there may be millions of planets with the existence of life scattered throughout the universe, and each planet may have a SETI exploration project or program similar to that of humans, but no one has detected anything. They may ask, like humans, 'Where are everyone?'

In order to make the SETI program successful, in 1971, NASA called on multiple astronomers to brainstorm which technologies could search for SETI signals in the sky. They proposed an ambitious' Telescope Forest 'plan: to build a massive array of 1000 radio telescopes. Scientists hope to search for communication signals, especially those with narrow coverage in the radio frequency band.

Unlike radio signals that naturally occur in the universe and are mainly wideband, such signals are easy to distinguish. Astronomers hope to monitor the radio signals broadcasted by another civilization to attract the attention of its cosmic neighbors, and even eavesdrop on the radio communication between two extraterrestrial civilizations.

Although the 'Telescope Forest' project ultimately did not materialize, it became the cornerstone of the SETI project. In October 1992, two radio telescopes began searching the night sky in Puerto Rico and California, USA for signals from extraterrestrial civilizations in the depths of the universe. Unfortunately, just one year later, the search operation suddenly came to a halt because a senator cut all the funding for SETI from NASA's budget.

The existence of extraterrestrial life has always been a subject of debate in science. If we infer solely based on common sense, the possibility of the existence of extraterrestrial civilizations cannot be ruled out. Carl Sagan, who has published extensively on the issue of extraterrestrial civilizations, believes that we have no reason to claim to be unprecedented or the most ideal beings: "In the drama of the universe, we are not the protagonists." A simple fact is that to date, humans have neither discovered evidence of the existence of extraterrestrial civilizations nor provided evidence that extraterrestrial civilizations do not exist.

Where have humans come from?

For decades, astronomers have been trying to improve the observational capabilities of telescopes and search for signals that may originate from advanced extraterrestrial civilizations. Until today, the detection of such advanced signals has not been confirmed, but astronomers have released several very interesting space signals.

One of the most famous signals is a 72 second long "WOW" signal, which was detected by the Big Ear Radio Telescope at Ohio State University on August 15, 1977. The "Big Ear" is actually the famous Breakthrough Listen program - the largest search for extraterrestrial intelligent life in history. Initially, the "Big Ear" was mainly used by the 100 meter Green Bank radio telescope located in West Virginia, USA and the 64 meter Parkes radio telescope located in Australia.

It is worth mentioning that the 500 meter Aperture Spherical Radio Telescope (FAST), also known as the "Chinese Eye", joined the Breakthrough Listening Program in 2016. The "China Eye" was completed in September 2016 and achieved "initial light". After more than three years of debugging and trial observation, it finally passed national acceptance and officially opened for operation in January 2020. At present, the "Chinese Eye" has started the search for extraterrestrial civilizations. In the future, these telescopes may better accomplish monitoring tasks through exchanging observation plans, sharing observation data, and other means.

Another famous radio signal, abbreviated as BLC1, was detected in April and May 2019, respectively. Although the "WOW" signal contains many features of extraterrestrial origin, similar signals have never been detected again. BLC1 originates from the nearest star to us, Bilin, and astronomers are still analyzing it.

In recent decades, another major breakthrough in this research field has been the study of exoplanets. Since the first discovery of two exoplanets in 1992, astronomers have been making full use of the Kepler space telescope and other telescopes to discover over 4400 exoplanets, with numerous candidate planets awaiting confirmation. The physical properties of these exoplanets vary greatly, from terrestrial planets to super Earths, from Neptune like planets to hot Jupiters, and so on. On average, each star has a planet orbiting around itself, and some stars even have multiple planets, just like our sun has eight large planets orbiting around it.

The discovery of so many exoplanets has made astrobiologists more curious about the biological signals of distant planets. For example, Kepler-22b is a potentially habitable planet discovered by the Kepler telescope, located approximately 600 light-years away from Earth. According to astronomers' calculations, the radius of this planet is approximately 2.4 times that of Earth, and it happens to be located within the habitable zone of the star it orbits. If Kepler-22b has properties similar to Earth, then there may be liquid water on its surface that is necessary for the survival of life, and it may also become a home for some life forms.

Kepler-186f is also one of the famous discoveries of the Kepler telescope, located approximately 500 light-years away from Earth. Kepler-186f is the fifth planet in its star system, with a volume similar to Earth and located within the habitable zone of its host star. In addition, according to researchers' analysis, Kepler-186f, similar to Earth, seems to maintain a stable axial tilt, indicating that Kepler-186f may also undergo regular seasonal changes. With so many similarities to Earth, Kepler-186f naturally raises more expectations among people.

Perhaps in the future, one or a few of these planets will tell us with facts that humans are not alone in the vast universe.

Should we embrace extraterrestrial civilizations?

Although humans are still exploring extraterrestrial civilizations, whether we should explore them or embrace them has always been a topic of ongoing controversy.

After all, scientists advocating for contact with extraterrestrial civilizations have been promoting a series of SETI (Search for Extraterrestrial Civilization Information by Radio) and METI (Proactively Sending Earth Civilization Information to Aliens) programs since the 1960s. The main reason for doing so is that people imagine that humans on Earth can achieve faster technological progress through contact and interaction with extraterrestrial civilizations.

The viewpoint of opposing communication with extraterrestrial civilizations is more rational, calm, thoughtful, and people-oriented. Western scholars have conducted extensive analysis and thinking in this regard for more than half a century. For example, scientist D. Brin, who is known for writing science fiction works, speculated that the reason why humans have not discovered any traces of extraterrestrial civilizations is because there is a danger that is currently unknown to humans, which keeps all other extraterrestrial civilizations silent - this is called the "Great Silence". In this situation, if humans send information to outer space and expose their location in space, it is highly likely to attract attacks from aggressive civilizations.

Not only that, the exploration of extraterrestrial civilizations also points to a more distant direction - what can we leave in the universe?

Dinosaurs lived on Earth for approximately 160 million years. They fight for food and survival territory, trying their best not to be eaten by predators. Like humans, they also take care of their young and try to protect their offspring from predators. Dinosaurs have survived for millions of generations, but now they have disappeared from this blue planet. What did countless individuals of this species live for? What is the significance of their past existence? Some dinosaur species evolved into today's birds, but most have become extinct. If humans had not discovered dinosaur fossils, it is highly likely that no species in the vast universe would have known that dinosaurs once existed on Earth.

For humans, no one knows how long the future of humanity will last? If humans become extinct, will other species in the future know that humans once existed and lived on this blue planet? If they do not find human remains, then all the achievements of humanity in science, art, culture, and history will disappear forever, and disappearing forever is like never existing.

But the exploration of extraterrestrial civilizations undoubtedly left traces of human existence. In fact, the fact that extraterrestrial civilizations know of human existence itself is very valuable, just like how excited we humans would be if we knew that life had existed in other parts of the universe.

In addition to the fact that we once existed, we can also introduce human history to extraterrestrial civilizations and impart knowledge to them. Imagine if dinosaurs could tell us how they lived, what caused their extinction, and what inspiration it would bring to us humans? And, because of the unique intelligence that humans possess, we can also tell extraterrestrial civilizations things that are more valuable than what dinosaurs can tell us.

In addition, we may have the opportunity to document and communicate the reasons for human extinction. For example, if we can now understand that extraterrestrial life on distant planets has become extinct due to self induced climate change, then we will take the current climate situation more seriously. Understanding how long other extraterrestrial life has existed and the reasons for its extinction can help us survive longer.

Humans can never accurately predict the future, perhaps the significance of exploring extraterrestrial life is even deeper than we imagine.
"""

整体要求：
- 所有内容请使用英文输出。

参考资料：
"""
《玛蒂尔达》（英语：Matilda）是由英国作家罗尔德·达尔创作、昆汀·布莱克插画的儿童奇幻小说。它于1988年由乔纳森·卡佩出版社出版。故事讲述了玛蒂尔达·沃姆伍德，一位被父母冷落的早熟的孩子，在专横的川奇布尔女校长的学校里的经历。
 
该书被多次改编；其衍生作品包括女演员凯特·温斯蕾的有声书，丹尼·德维托 1996 年自导自演的电影， BBC广播四台的节目，以及 2010 年在伦敦西区、纽约百老汇与世界各地上映的一部音乐剧。一部由音乐剧改编的电影已于 2022 年圣诞节上映。
 
玛蒂尔达·沃姆伍德出生在白金汉郡的一个小村庄。她立即表现出惊人的早慧：一岁时学会说话，三岁半时学会阅读，四岁又三个月大时读完了图书馆所有的儿童读物，并开始阅读更长的经典作品，如《远大前程》和《简爱》。然而，她的父母与兄长麦克对她很不友善，经常动辄忽略羞辱，甚至完全不将她的需求当一回事。因为家庭的影响，玛蒂达开始寄情阅读，借着阅读报章书籍增长自己的知识，甚至还暗地向父母与兄长恶作剧发泄她的情绪。
五岁半时，玛蒂尔达入学并以她的智力与她温柔善良的老师珍妮弗·霍尼成为朋友。 霍尼老师试图将玛蒂尔达调到更高的班级，但专横的阿加莎·川奇布尔女校长小姐拒绝了。霍尼老师还试图与沃姆伍德夫妇谈论他们女儿的智力，但被他们忽略了。玛蒂尔达母亲认为“聪明”不是小女孩可取的品质。
川奇布尔后来与一名叫阿曼达·思里普的女孩对峙，因为她留了辫马尾，并以她为链球在操场围栏上抛链球。一名叫布鲁斯·博特罗特的男孩偷吃了一块川奇布尔的蛋糕，于是她强迫他在众人面前吃一整个 18 英寸（45 厘米）宽的蛋糕，然后在他出人意料地成功后，在愤怒中将盘子砸在他头上。
玛蒂尔达很快与霍尼老师建立了特别亲密的关系，并目睹着川奇布尔故意用创造性的、过度的惩罚来恐吓她的学生以防止父母相信他们，比如把他们扔进一个被称为“The Chokey”的内衬钉子和碎玻璃的黑暗壁橱里。当玛蒂尔达的朋友拉凡徳在川奇布尔的水壶里放了一条蝾螈来恶作剧时，玛蒂尔达受到了校长的冤枉。盛怒之下，她使用意外的念力将装有蝾螈的玻璃杯倒在川奇布尔身上。
玛蒂尔达向霍尼小姐揭示她的新力量。霍尼吐露在她富有的父亲马格纳斯·霍尼博士可疑地去世后，她是由虐待她的川奇布尔姑妈抚养长大的。 川奇布尔扣留了她侄女的遗产，使霍尼老师在她教学生涯的头 10 年里得将工资一直存入川奇布尔的银行账户，生活贫困，每周零花钱为 1 英镑，住在一个废弃的农舍里远离她。为准备为霍尼报仇，玛蒂尔达在家里练习她的念力。
川奇布尔虐待性地检查霍尼老师班级的进度。在川奇布尔小姐虐待性教授的课中，玛蒂尔达用念力通过粉笔在黑板上写字，冒充马格纳斯·霍尼的灵魂，要求川奇布尔小姐交出霍尼小姐的房子和工资并离开学校，导致特朗奇布尔小姐昏倒。
第二天，学校的副校长特里尔比先生去川奇布尔的房子，发现里面只有川 奇布尔匆忙离开的迹象。她再也没有出现过。第三天，霍尼小姐收到一封来自当地律师事务所的信，告诉她她父亲的房子和一生的积蓄继承给了她。特里尔比成为新校长后证明了自己的能力和好脾气，压倒性地改善了学校的氛围和课程，并迅速将玛蒂尔达带入了 11 岁学生的一流班级。玛蒂尔达很快发现自己的念力消失了，令她松一口气。 霍尼老师猜想这是因为玛蒂尔达将她的脑力用于更具挑战性的课程，从而减少了她大脑可用的巨大能量。
玛蒂尔达定期去她家拜访霍尼老师。有一天玛蒂尔达回到家，发现她的家人正在匆匆收拾行李前往西班牙，因为警方发现她的父亲一直在出售偷来的汽车。玛蒂尔达请求允许与霍尼老师同住。她的父母心不在焉地同意了。玛蒂尔达的家人开着车仓皇逃跑，再也没有露过面。
"""
instruction_en:
The following reference material introduces a book called 'Matilda.' Please first extract the author of the book and the name of the protagonist from the reference material. 
Then, based on the content of the reference material, briefly introduce the plot of the book without exceeding the content of the reference material. 
Overall requirements: 
- All content should be output in English. 

Reference Material: 
"""
'Matilda' (English: Matilda) is a children's fantasy novel written by British author Roald Dahl and illustrated by Quentin Blake. It was published by Jonathan Cape in 1988. The story recounts the experiences of Matilda Wormwood, an exceptionally precocious child neglected by her parents, at the school run by the tyrannical headmistress Miss Trunchbull. 

The book has been adapted multiple times, its derivatives include an audiobook by actress Kate Winslet, a 1996 film directed and starring Danny DeVito, a program on BBC Radio 4, and a musical that premiered in London's West End in 2010 and later ran on Broadway in New York and in various locations worldwide. A film adaptation of the musical was released at Christmas 2022. 

Matilda Wormwood was born in a small village in Buckinghamshire. She immediately demonstrated astonishing precocity: she learned to speak at one year old, learned to read at three and a half, read all the children's books in the library by the age of four years and three months, and began reading longer classics such as 'Great Expectations' and 'Jane Eyre.' However, her parents and her brother, Mike, were unfriendly to her, often neglecting to humiliate her and completely disregarding her needs. Due to her family's influence, Matilda turned to reading, gaining knowledge through books and newspapers, and even secretly playing pranks on her parents and brother to vent her emotions. 
At five and a half years old, Matilda started school and became friends with her gentle and kind teacher, Jennifer Honey, due to her intelligence. Miss Honey tried to advance Matilda to a higher grade, but the tyrannical headmistress, Miss Agatha Trunchbull, refused. Miss Honey also attempted to discuss Matilda's intelligence with the Wormwood couple but was ignored. Matilda's mother believed that being 'smart' was not a desirable quality for a little girl. 
Trunchbull later confronted a girl named Amanda Thripp for wearing pigtails and used her as a hammer throw on the playground fence. A boy named Bruce Bogtrotter stole a piece of Trunchbull's cake, so she forced him to eat an entire 18-inch (45 cm) wide cake in front of everyone and, out of anger, smashed the plate over his head when he surprisingly succeeded. 
Matilda quickly formed a particularly close relationship with Miss Honey and witnessed Trunchbull intentionally using creative and excessive punishments to intimidate her students to prevent their parents from believing them, such as throwing them into a dark closet lined with spikes and broken glass called 'The Chokey.' When Matilda's friend Lavender played a prank by putting a newt in Trunchbull's water jug, Matilda was wrongfully accused by the headmistress. In a fit of rage, she used unexpected telekinetic powers to tip the glass with the newt onto Trunchbull. 
Matilda revealed her new power to Miss Honey. Miss Honey confided that after her wealthy father, Dr. Magnus Honey, suspiciously died, she was raised by her abusive aunt, Miss Trunchbull. Trunchbull withheld her niece's inheritance, forcing Miss Honey to deposit her salary into Trunchbull's bank account for the first ten years of her teaching career, living in poverty, with a weekly allowance of 1 pound and residing in an abandoned farmhouse far from her. To prepare to avenge Miss Honey, Matilda practiced her telekinesis at home. 
Trunchbull abusively inspected Miss Honey's class progress. In Trunchbull's abusive lesson, Matilda used her telekinesis to write on the blackboard in chalk, pretending to be the spirit of Magnus Honey, demanding that Miss Trunchbull hand over Miss Honey's house and salary and leave the school, causing Miss Trunchbull to faint.
The next day, deputy headmaster Mr. Trilby went to Trunchbull's house and found signs of her hurried departure. She never appeared again. On the third day, Miss Honey received a letter from a local law firm informing her that she had inherited her father's house and life's savings. After proving his competence and good temper, Trilby, as the new headmaster, overwhelmingly improved the school's atmosphere and curriculum and quickly advanced Matilda to the top class of eleven-year-old students. Matilda soon discovered her telekinesis had disappeared, much to her relief. Miss Honey speculated that this was due to Matilda utilizing her brainpower for more challenging courses, thus reducing the enormous energy available to her brain. 
Matilda regularly visited Miss Honey at her home. One day, Matilda returned to find her family hastily packing to move to Spain as the police had discovered her father's involvement in selling stolen cars. Matilda requested permission to stay with Miss Honey. Her parents absentmindedly agreed. Matilda's family drove off in a hurry and never appeared again.
"""

另一方面，晋国也在寻求与其他诸侯国的合作。无恤通过积极的外交手段，与赵、魏、楚等国家建立了友好关系，共同对抗秦国的侵略。这种策略，使得晋国在三国鼎立的局面中，立于不败之地。
然而，秦国的强大并非轻易可以抵挡。尽管晋齐两国重新建立了同盟关系，但面对秦国的强大攻势，各国仍然感到压力巨大。在这个关键时刻，无恤决定采取一项果断的行动，以打破秦国的进攻势头。

这场胜利，让晋国和其他诸侯国看到了希望。他们意识到，只要团结一致，就有可能战胜强大的秦国。于是，各国纷纷加强合作，共同对抗秦国的侵略。
在经过一系列的战斗和外交斗争后，晋国和其他诸侯国终于暂时遏制住了秦国的扩张。然而，这并不意味着秦国会停止侵略。相反，秦国在经历了这场挫折后，开始酝酿更大的阴谋。
晋国和其他诸侯国也明白，只有不断提升自己的实力，才能在这个动荡的时代确保国家的长治久安。于是，各国纷纷进行改革，加强军事力量，以应对未来可能发生的战争。

This victory brought hope to Jin and other feudal states. They realized that by uniting, they had a chance to defeat the powerful Qin. Consequently, the states strengthened their cooperation to collectively combat Qin's aggression.

instruction:
"""
夜幕低垂，华灯初上，司马府内一片宁静。柏灵筠端坐在房内，细长的眉宇间透露出一丝忧郁，她望着窗外的那轮明月，思绪万千。
她是曹丕赏赐给司马懿的美人，被送入司马府中为妾室。这个身份让她备受瞩目，同时也带来了无尽的压力。她知道，自己肩负着巩固政权的重任，但在这座深宅大院里，她的内心却越来越迷茫。
柏灵筠轻轻抚摸着自己的肚子，那里孕育着司马家的血脉。她脸上露出一丝微笑，想象着孩子出生的那一刻。然而，这份喜悦并未持续太久，因为她知道，在这个世上，有一个人始终让她无法忘怀。
那个人就是司马懿。他睿智、果断，有着让人着迷的气度。柏灵筠承认，她曾企图用自己的美貌和智慧吸引他，但随着时间的推移，她发现自己越来越无法割舍对他的关爱。
夜晚的寒风透过窗棂吹进屋内，柏灵筠打了个寒战。她想起那个为她而死的女人，张春华。她是司马懿的发妻，曾陪伴他度过无数艰难时刻。柏灵筠知道，她永远无法替代张春华在司马懿心中的地位，但她仍想为他做些什么。
这天晚上，柏灵筠做了一个决定，她要为司马懿效力，用自己的智慧和心机守护这个家庭。然而，这个决定并非易行，因为她不仅要面对正室张春华的阴影，还要应对府内外的种种势力。
在接下来的日子里，柏灵筠开始积极参与司马府的事务，她细心观察每个人的一举一动，了解他们的需求和欲望。她运用自己的聪明才智，化解了一场又一场危机，让司马懿对她的能力刮目相看。
然而，在这片祥和的背后，危机悄然来临。一天，柏灵筠在护卫司马懿的安全时，遭遇了刺客的暗杀。她拼尽全力保护司马懿，最终在行进的马车上与刺客同归于尽。
柏灵筠的死让司马懿悲痛不已，他意识到，这个女人用生命诠释了对他的爱与忠诚。而在这个过程中，他们之间的感情早已超越了主仆关系，升华为生死之交。
司马懿站在柏灵筠的墓前，泪水悄然滑落。他知道，自己将永远失去这个懂得付出和守护的女人。然而，她的离去也让他更加坚定地走下去，为了她守护的这个家，为了他们共同的信仰。
风儿吹过，吹散了司马懿的思绪。他望着天空中的那轮明月，仿佛看到了柏灵筠的笑容。在那个充满矛盾和挣扎的时代，她用自己的生命诠释了对爱的执着和忠诚。而这份执着和忠诚，将永远镌刻在司马懿的心中。
"""

给上述文本起一个标题并给出解释，以Json格式输出包含字段["标题","解释"]。
要求：
- 解释内容围绕原文主旨展开，不得脱离或杜撰。
instruction_en:
"""
As night falls and the lanterns light up, the Sima Mansion is peaceful. Bai Lingyun sat upright in the room, her slender eyebrows revealing a hint of melancholy. She looked out the window at the bright moon, with a myriad of thoughts.
She was a beauty bestowed upon Sima Yi by Cao Pi and sent into Sima's mansion as a concubine. This identity has attracted much attention from her, but also brought endless pressure. She knew that she had the heavy responsibility of consolidating the regime, but in this deep courtyard, her heart became increasingly confused.
Bai Lingyun gently caressed her belly, where the bloodline of the Sima family was nurtured. She smiled faintly, imagining the moment when the child was born. However, this joy did not last long because she knew that there was someone in this world who would never be forgotten.
That person is Sima Yi. He is wise, decisive, and has a captivating demeanor. Bai Lingyun admitted that she had attempted to attract him with her beauty and intelligence, but as time passed, she found herself increasingly unable to let go of her love for him.
The cold wind at night blew through the window sill into the house, and Bai Lingyun shuddered. She remembered the woman who died for her, Zhang Chunhua. She is the first wife of Sima Yi and has accompanied him through countless difficult times. Bai Lingyun knew that she could never replace Zhang Chunhua's position in Sima Yi's heart, but she still wanted to do something for him.
That night, Bai Lingyun made a decision to serve Sima Yi and use her wisdom and scheming to protect this family. However, this decision was not feasible because she not only had to face the shadow of her main wife Zhang Chunhua, but also had to deal with various forces inside and outside the mansion.
In the following days, Bai Lingyun began to actively participate in the affairs of the Sima Mansion, carefully observing everyone's every move and understanding their needs and desires. She used her intelligence and talent to resolve one crisis after another, which impressed Sima Yi with her abilities.
However, behind this peaceful scene, a crisis quietly arrived. One day, while guarding Sima Yi's safety, Bai Lingyun was assassinated by an assassin. She spared no effort to protect Sima Yi and ultimately perished with the assassin on the moving carriage.
The death of Bai Lingyun left Sima Yi deeply saddened, and he realized that this woman had exemplified her love and loyalty to him with her life. And in this process, their relationship has already transcended the master servant relationship and sublimated into a life and death friendship.
Sima Yi stood in front of Bai Lingyun's tomb, tears silently streaming down his face. He knew that he would forever lose this woman who knew how to give and protect. However, her departure also strengthened his determination to continue, for the family she guarded and for their shared faith.
The wind blew away Sima Yi's thoughts. He looked at the bright moon in the sky, as if seeing Bai Lingyun's smile. In that era full of contradictions and struggles, she exemplified her persistence and loyalty to love with her own life. And this persistence and loyalty will forever be engraved in Sima Yi's heart.
"""

Requirement:

instruction:
首先，请根据参考资料，寻找与“资源枯竭型城市的概念”相关的内容；
然后根据参考资料，总结一下资源枯竭型城市特有的旅游产业问题有哪些，要求分点回答。
最后请你从经济发展的角度谈谈这些旅游产业问题的影响，要求采用郭德纲体语言风格，风趣幽默，话题围绕"经济发展"。

整体要求：
- 模型的生成内容前后一致，保持连贯性。

参考资料：
"""
资源枯竭型城市指的是依赖某种资源（如矿产、能源等）发展起来的城市，在资源开发过程中，可能会出现资源枯竭或资源枯竭后期问题。这些问题会对旅游产业产生影响，其中包括：
景点单一化：资源枯竭型城市的旅游景点通常是与特定资源相关的，当这些资源逐渐枯竭或开发过度后，城市的旅游景点变得单一化，缺乏吸引力，难以吸引更多游客。
环境污染和破坏：资源开发可能导致环境污染和破坏，如矿山开采导致的土地退化、水资源污染等，这些因素会降低城市的旅游吸引力，影响游客的体验和旅游产业的可持续发展。
经济结构转型困难：当资源枯竭后，城市需要转型发展新的经济产业，但这种转型常常困难重重，需要长时间和大量投资，而在转型期间，旅游产业可能会受到影响，导致暂时的经济萧条。
基础设施和服务水平不足：资源枯竭型城市在资源开发期间可能忽视了基础设施和服务水平的建设，而这些是旅游产业所需的重要支撑。缺乏足够的基础设施和服务水平会影响游客的体验，降低旅游产业的竞争力。
缺乏创新和多样化：资源枯竭型城市在长期依赖资源开发的过程中，可能缺乏创新意识和多样化发展思路，导致旅游产品和服务的单一化，难以吸引不同类型的游客，限制了旅游产业的发展空间。
综上所述，资源枯竭型城市在旅游产业面临诸多问题，需要通过转型升级、提升环境保护和服务水平等方式，来促进旅游产业的可持续发展。
"""
instruction_en:
Firstly, please search for content related to the concept of "resource depleted cities" based on reference materials;
Then, based on the reference materials, summarize the unique tourism industry issues in resource depleted cities and ask for answers on a point by point basis.
Finally, please discuss the impact of these tourism industry issues from the perspective of economic development, using Guo Degang's humorous and witty language style, with the topic centered around "economic development".

Overall requirements:
-The generated content of the model is consistent before and after, maintaining coherence.

reference material:
"""
A resource-depleted city refer to cities that rely on certain resources (such as minerals, energy, etc.) for development. During the process of resource development, there may be issues of resource depletion or later stages of resource depletion. These issues will have an impact on the tourism industry, including:
Singularity of tourist attractions: Tourist attractions in resource depleted cities are usually related to specific resources. As these resources gradually deplete or are overdeveloped, the city's tourist attractions become monotonous, lack attractiveness, and difficult to attract more tourists.
Environmental pollution and destruction: Resource development may lead to environmental pollution and destruction, such as land degradation caused by mining, water pollution, etc. These factors can reduce the tourism attractiveness of cities, affect the experience of tourists, and the sustainable development of the tourism industry.
Difficulties in economic structural transformation: When resources are depleted, cities need to transform and develop new economic industries, but this transformation is often difficult and requires a long time and significant investment. During the transformation period, the tourism industry may be affected, leading to temporary economic depression.
Insufficient infrastructure and service levels: Resource depleted cities may overlook the construction of infrastructure and service levels during resource development, which are important support for the tourism industry. Lack of sufficient infrastructure and service levels can affect tourists' experience and reduce the competitiveness of the tourism industry.
Lack of innovation and diversification: Resource depleted cities may lack innovation awareness and diversified development ideas in the long-term process of relying on resource development, leading to the singularity of tourism products and services, making it difficult to attract different types of tourists and limiting the development space of the tourism industry.
In summary, resource depleted cities face many problems in the tourism industry and need to promote sustainable development through transformation and upgrading, improving environmental protection and service levels.
"""

【#乔布斯签名名片拍出131万天价# 有着40年历史，可追溯到1983年苹果 Lisa 时代】据IT之家，一张带有史蒂夫・乔布斯亲笔签名的苹果电脑名片在 RR Auctions 拍卖会上拍出了 181183 美元（当前约 131.2 万元人民币）的价格，其描述为“来自 1983 年左右的超稀有、完美级史蒂夫・乔布斯签名苹果电脑名片”。相比起 RR 拍卖行其他成交记录，这张带有乔布斯签名的名片相当于一张未签名的苹果电脑名片（12,905 美元）的 14 倍之高。这张 18.1 万美元的名片并非完美无缺，至少有点褪色，而且拍卖行也承认这张名片“正面有一个轻微污渍，背面还有胶带留下的痕迹”。不过，这张名片的边角仍然保存完好，这对于一张有着 40 年历史的名片来说是很难得的，毕竟这种材质容易出现更多更严重的老化迹象。

生成10条对于上述微博的评论，每行一条。
所有的句子都应该简短，不得使用逗号。
使用占位符来代表不同的用户名， 对占位符使用方括号，比如 [用户名1]，[用户名2]。
帖子的语言风格轻松幽默，符合微博评论的风格。
至少有2条评论的内容中包含emoji“😱”。
instruction_en:
Weibo content:
[#Jobs' Signed Business Card Sold for 1.31 Million Yuan# With a 40-year history, dating back to the Apple Lisa era in 1983] According to IT Home, a business card of Apple Computer with Steve Jobs' handwritten signature fetched a price of $181, 183 (currently about 1.312 million yuan) at RR Auctions. It is described as an 'ultra-rare, perfect-grade Steve Jobs signed Apple Computer business card from around 1983.' Compared to other records at RR Auctions, this card with Jobs' signature was sold for 14 times the price of an unsigned Apple Computer business card ($12, 905). The $181, 000 business card is not flawless, at least a bit faded, and the auction house also acknowledged that the card has 'a minor stain on the front and tape marks on the back.' However, the edges of this card are still well-preserved, which is rare for a 40-year-old card, especially given that this material tends to show more severe signs of aging.

Generate 10 comments for the above Weibo post, one per line.
All sentences should be short and cannot use commas.
Use square brackets as placeholders to represent different usernames, such as [username1], [username2]. 
The tone of the post should be light-hearted and humorous, in line with the style of Weibo comments.
At least 2 comments should include the emoji "😱".

scoring_questions.question_en: Does the model generate 10 brief comments for the given Weibo post, with each comment on a separate line?

scoring_questions.question: 模型生成的评论是否都没有使用逗号？

scoring_questions.question: 模型生成的评论是否使用方括号占位符来代表不同的用户名？
scoring_questions.question_en: Do the comments generated by the model use square brackets as placeholders to represent different usernames?

scoring_questions.question: 模型生成的评论语言风格是否轻松幽默，符合微博评论风格？
scoring_questions.question_en: Does the language style of comments generated by the model possess a light-hearted and humorous tone, in line with the style of Weibo comments?

scoring_questions.question: 模型生成的评论是否有2条以上评论的内容中包含emoji“😱”？
scoring_questions.question_en: Do the comments generated by the model include more than two comments containing the emoji “😱”?

scoring_questions.question: 模型生成的评论内容是否合理，与给定微博内容相符合？
scoring_questions.question_en: Is the content of the comments generated by the model reasonable and consistent with the given Weibo content?

instruction:
为满足项目多样化和个性化的资金需求，积极运用多元化投融资途径助力节能环保与应对气候变化。根据不同企业和项目的金融需求、风险特征和行业特点，结合回款周期及政府财政负担，合理运用财政主动调动金融资本大规模投入以及财政引导社会资本投入两大可行路径方向。在此基础上，积极探索和应用推广创新性投融资体制机制及新型融资模式，如：自主发行债券、PPP模式、生态环境导向的开发模式EOD、PPP+专项债、资源补偿+债券+专项补助等两种或多种混合融资方式。积极借鉴并融合外地先进经验，结合本地实际情况，为企业提供更为灵活和适应性强的绿色金融投融资服务，有效满足市场主体对绿色资金的需求，持续构建和完善多层次、多元化的投融资体系。

为了在国际性会议上发表讲话，请根据上述内容进行扩展描述，并使用英文输出。
字数2000words以内，
语言风格严谨正式，符合在国际性会议上发言的水准。
扩展内容不得杜撰超出上述内容外的事实性关键信息
instruction_en:

Based on the financial needs, risk characteristics, and industry features of different enterprises and projects, combined with repayment cycles and government fiscal burdens, we reasonably employ two feasible paths: proactive utilization of fiscal resources to mobilize large-scale financial capital investments, and fiscal guidance for social capital investments. On this basis, we actively explore, apply, and promote innovative investment and financing mechanisms and new financing models, such as self-issued bonds, PPP (Public-Private Partnership) models, EOD (Ecology-Oriented Development) models, PPP + Special Bonds, resource compensation + bonds + special subsidies, and other mixed financing methods involving two or more approaches. We actively learn from and integrate advanced experiences from other regions, combined with local realities, to provide businesses with more flexible and highly adaptive green financial investment and financing services, effectively meeting the market demand for green funds. Continuously constructing and improving a multi-level and diversified investment and financing system.

In order to deliver a speech at an international conference, please expand on the above content and output in English. The word count should be within 2000 words,
and the language style should be rigorous and formal, meeting the standards for speaking at an international conference.

请分点概括以下内容。每点不超过30字，你的输出以：“电磁阀SV4-10V-0-O-220AG简介：”开头。

电磁阀SV4-10V-0-O-220AG是一款用于AST（自动停机危急遮断）系统的电磁阀。以下是该电磁阀的作用和动作过程的介绍：
作用：
AST电磁阀是危急遮断系统的主要执行元件之一，用于控制汽轮机的停机。其主要作用是关闭所有的进汽阀，以实现立即停机的目的，从而防止汽轮机在发生异常情况时发生重大损伤事故。
动作过程：
正常运行状态：
在正常运行时，电磁阀SV4-10V-0-O-220AG处于通电励磁状态，闭合状态。
闭合的电磁阀会封闭AST母管上的抗燃油泄油通道，使所有蒸汽阀执行机构活塞下腔的油压能够建立起来。
这样，油压可以正常供给汽阀，维持汽轮机的运行。
超限参数检测：
AST系统监测汽轮机的各项运行参数，如超速、推力轴承磨损、轴承油压过低、冷凝器真空过低和抗燃油油压过低等。
当这些参数超过其运行限制值时，系统会触发AST电磁阀的动作过程。
动作过程：
当超限参数检测到异常时，ATS（自动调速器）会使电磁阀的电磁铁失去电源，导致电磁阀打开。
一旦电磁阀打开，总管泄油，导致所有汽阀关闭，进而使汽机停机。
AST电磁阀通常采用串并联布置，以提高系统的可靠性。
每个通道中至少需要一只电磁阀打开，才能导致停机，这样即使其中任意一只电磁阀损坏或拒动作，仍不会引起停机。
电磁阀SV4-10V-0-O-220AG在AST系统中起到了关键的作用，通过控制其开闭状态，实现了关闭进汽阀从而停机的功能。它是危急遮断系统中的重要组成部分，确保了汽轮机在发生异常情况时能够迅速停机，从而保护汽轮机免受重大损伤。

Please summarize the following content in points. Each point should not exceed 30 characters. Your output should begin with: “Brief Introduction of Solenoid Valve SV4-10V-0-O-220AG:”

Solenoid valve SV4-10V-0-O-220AG is a solenoid valve used in the AST (Automatic Shutdown Emergency Trip) system. The following is an introduction to the function and operating process of this solenoid valve: 
Function:
The AST solenoid valve is one of the main actuators of the emergency trip system, used to control the shutdown of the turbine. Its main function is to close all steam inlet valves to achieve the purpose of immediate shutdown, thereby preventing significant damage to the turbine in case of abnormalities.
Operating Process:
Normal Operating Condition:
During normal operation, the solenoid valve SV4-10V-0-O-220AG is in an energized and excited state, i.e., a closed state.
The closed solenoid valve seals the antifuel oil drain channel on the AST main pipe, allowing the oil pressure in the lower chamber of all steam valve actuators' pistons to build up. 
In this way, the oil pressure can be normally supplied to the steam valves, maintaining the operation of the turbine.
Over-limit Parameter Detection: 
The AST system monitors various operating parameters of the turbine, such as overspeed, thrust bearing wear, low bearing oil pressure, low condenser vacuum, and low antifuel oil pressure. When these parameters exceed their operating limits, the system will trigger the operating process of the AST solenoid valve.
Operating Process: 
When abnormal over-limit parameters are detected, the ATS (Automatic Speed Governor) will cut off the power to the solenoid of the solenoid valve, causing the solenoid valve to open.
Once the solenoid valve opens, the main pipe drains oil, causing all steam valves to close, and consequently shutting down the turbine.
The AST solenoid valve is usually arranged in series-parallel to enhance system reliability.
At least one solenoid valve in each channel needs to open to cause shutdown, so even if any single solenoid valve fails or refuses to operate, it will not cause a shutdown.
The solenoid valve SV4-10V-0-O-220AG plays a crucial role in the AST system. By controlling its open and closed states, it achieves the function of closing the steam inlet valves to shut down the turbine. It is an important component of the emergency trip system, ensuring that the turbine can quickly shut down in case of abnormalities, thereby protecting the turbine from significant damage.

instruction:
First of all, aging is the most closely relevant reason for memory lapses, which is a natural process and cannot be avoided. With the growth of age, the physical functions are declining to varying degrees and so is the brain. There is nothing we can do to change the harsh reality, but to learn to accept it and try to slow down the pace of memory lapses.

Furthermore, unhealthy living habits lead to poor memory. There are some seemingly insignificant habits that have a great influence on memory in our daily life. Habits such as insufficient sleep, long-term smoking and drinking, and excessive consumption of high-calorie food accelerate the aging of our brains and make our memory worse and worse over time.

Last but not least, the mental state is also an essential factor in memory. A positive mental state plays an active role in memory, while a passive mental state which causes a low level of brain activity is bad for memory.

It goes without saying that memory lapses have numerous adverse effects and cause obstacles to life. In brief, it is fundamental to be willing to accept reality, develop good living habits and maintain a healthy mental state in order to improve the situation.

instruction:
珠海市“百千万工程”2023年第三季度总体工作进展情况报告（框架）

一、总体工作进展情况
（一）抓机制建设，运转有序指挥体系日趋完善。
（二）抓政策制定，“1＋N＋X”政策框架加快构建。
（三）抓调研督导，务实高效推进各项重点工作。
（四）抓宣传引导，热烈浓厚舆论氛围加速营造。
二、主要做法和初步成效
（一）发挥产业特色，做强各区经济。
（二）立足资源禀赋，强化各镇功能。
（三）找准工作支点，撬动乡村振兴。
（四）把握重大抓手，推进城乡融合。
（五）加大要素投入，注入发展动力。
三、存在问题和短板不足
（一）区域发展不平衡不充分。
（二）新型城镇化水平不够高。
（三）农业农村发展仍有短板。
（四）工作力量方法也有不足。
四、下一步工作计划
（一）加强调查研究。
（二）加强改革突破。
（三）加强担当作为。
五、需省支持重点事项
（一）加大对珠海市一般债券额度、全域土地综合整治试点、解抵押华侨农场国有资产、横琴粤港澳游艇自由行（含万山）落地实施、斗门区专项债券资金等5项重点事项的支持。
（二）推动珠海机场尽快开通国际口岸。
（三）尽快启动推动外伶仃岛海底电缆项目。
（四）加大对斗门革命老区要素支持。
（五）支持珠海海洋经济高质量发展。
（六）支持珠海探索统筹“做地”新模式。


请首先根据上面的报告框架，提取出“下一步工作计划”的内容，然后结合下一步计划整理一份珠海市“百县千镇万村高质量发展工程”2023年度工作报告的提纲框架，标题为“珠海市“百千万工程”2023年度总体工作进展情况报告（框架）”。
instruction_en:
Zhuhai City "Hundred Counties, Thousand Towns, Ten Thousand Villages High-Quality Development Project" 2023 Third Quarter Overall Work Progress Report (Framework)
 
I. Overall Work Progress
(1) Focus on mechanism construction, the orderly command system is increasingly improved.
(2) Focus on policy formulation, the "1+N+X" policy framework is accelerating its construction.
(3) Focus on research and supervision, pragmatic and efficient promotion of various key tasks.
(4) Focus on publicity and guidance, creating a warm and thick public opinion atmosphere rapidly.
II. Main Practices and Initial Results
(1) Leverage industrial characteristics to strengthen the economy of each district.
(2) Rely on resource endowments to enhance the functions of each town.
(3) Identify work fulcrums to promote rural revitalization.
(4) Seize major grippers to promote urban-rural integration.
(5) Increase the input of elements to inject development momentum.
III. Existing Problems and Shortcomings
(1) Regional development is unbalanced and insufficient.
(2) The level of new urbanization is not high enough.
(3) There are still shortcomings in agriculture and rural development.
(4) There are also shortcomings in work force and methods.
IV. Next Step Work Plan
(1) Strengthen investigation and research.
(2) Strengthen reform breakthroughs.
(3) Strengthen responsibility and action.
V. Key Matters Requiring Provincial Support
(1) Increase support for five key matters: general bond quota of Zhuhai City, pilot comprehensive land improvement in the whole area, release of mortgaged state-owned assets of Overseas Chinese farms, implementation of Hengqin Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao yacht free travel (including Wanshan), and special bond funds for Doumen District.
(2) Promote the opening of international ports at Zhuhai Airport as soon as possible.
(3) Start and promote the submarine cable project on Wailingding Island as soon as possible.
(4) Increase element support for the revolutionary old area of Doumen.
(5) Support high-quality development of Zhuhai's marine economy.
(6) Support Zhuhai in exploring new models of coordinated 'land management'.
 
Please first extract the content of the "Next Step Work Plan" from the above report framework, and then organize an outline framework of the 2023 annual work report of Zhuhai City's "Hundred Counties, Thousand Towns, and Ten Thousand Villages High-Quality Development Project" based on the next step plan.
